Voor Fivespark, een ambitieuze Managed Service Provider in Amstelveen, zoeken wij een Manager Service Operations & AI. In deze veelzijdige functie combineer je operationeel leiderschap met procesverbetering, automatisering en de verdere ontwikkeling van een eigen AI-agent.

Je krijgt de verantwoordelijkheid over een team van 12 supportprofessionals én speelt een belangrijke rol in de transformatie naar een steeds verder geautomatiseerde IT-dienstverlening.

Over Fivespark

Fivespark is een innovatieve Managed Service Provider die bedrijven en overheden ondersteunt met moderne IT-oplossingen.

De organisatie werkt aan de Managed Service Provider van de toekomst, waarin automatisering, kunstmatige intelligentie en datagedreven processen een steeds grotere rol spelen.

Een belangrijk onderdeel hiervan is Sparkle, een intern ontwikkelde AI-agent die nu al ondersteunt bij ticketregistratie, triage, klantvragen en routering. De ambitie is om Sparkle verder te ontwikkelen tot een volwaardige digitale collega die steeds meer operationele processen zelfstandig en betrouwbaar kan uitvoeren.

De organisatie kenmerkt zich door korte lijnen, een informele werksfeer en veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en verantwoordelijkheid.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Manager Service Operations & AI ben je verantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse aansturing en verdere professionalisering van de tweedelijns supportorganisatie. Tegelijkertijd speel je een centrale rol in het ontwikkelen en implementeren van AI en automatisering.

Je werkzaamheden bestaan uit vier belangrijke onderdelen.

Leidinggeven aan de supportorganisatie

  • Je geeft leiding aan een team van 12 tweedelijns supportmedewerkers.

  • Je coacht en ontwikkelt medewerkers en zorgt voor duidelijke prioriteiten, structuur en samenwerking.

  • Je bewaakt de kwaliteit, capaciteit, continuïteit en prestaties van de dienstverlening.

  • Je signaleert knelpunten en vertaalt deze naar concrete verbeteracties.

Doorontwikkelen van AI-agent Sparkle

  • Je bent functioneel eigenaar van Sparkle en bepaalt mede de visie, roadmap en prioriteiten.

  • Je vertaalt operationele uitdagingen naar praktische AI-toepassingen.

  • Je zorgt ervoor dat Sparkle veilig, betrouwbaar en gebruiksvriendelijk functioneert.

  • Je werkt samen met technische specialisten aan de verdere ontwikkeling van deze digitale collega.

Processen verbeteren en automatiseren

  • Je analyseert bestaande operationele processen en identificeert mogelijkheden voor automatisering.

  • Je optimaliseert workflows, kennisbanken en werkinstructies.

  • Je zorgt voor een goede samenwerking tussen medewerkers en AI.

  • Je draagt bij aan de ambitie om minimaal 75% van de standaard operationele processen met AI te ondersteunen of volledig te automatiseren.

Verandering begeleiden

  • Je werkt samen met Operations, Software Development, Business Consultancy en externe partners.

  • Je begeleidt medewerkers in de overgang naar een meer AI-gedreven manier van werken.

  • Je creëert draagvlak, communiceert helder en zorgt ervoor dat veranderingen daadwerkelijk worden doorgevoerd.

Wie zoeken wij?

Wij zoeken een operationeel sterke manager die structuur weet aan te brengen, medewerkers kan motiveren en tegelijkertijd vooruitkijkt naar de mogelijkheden van nieuwe technologie.

Je begrijpt hoe een IT-supportorganisatie werkt, weet hoe je processen beheersbaar en voorspelbaar maakt en krijgt energie van het continu verbeteren van de dienstverlening.

Daarnaast beschik je over:

  • Hbo- of wo-werk- en -denkniveau.

  • Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring binnen Managed Services, ICT Operations of IT Service Management.

  • Ervaring met het aansturing, coachen en ontwikkelen van operationele teams.

  • Goede kennis van ITIL-processen en servicemanagement.

  • Affiniteit met AI, automatisering en digitale innovatie.

  • Sterke analytische en organisatorische vaardigheden.

  • Het vermogen om technische mogelijkheden te vertalen naar concrete operationele verbeteringen.

  • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en ervaring met verandermanagement.

Je hoeft geen AI-developer te zijn. We zoeken juist iemand die begrijpt hoe je AI en automatisering succesvol inzet binnen een operationele IT-organisatie en medewerkers hierin weet mee te nemen.

Wat kun je verwachten?

Je komt rechtstreeks in dienst bij onze opdrachtgever en krijgt een sleutelrol binnen een organisatie die volop investeert in de toekomst van IT-dienstverlening.

Je kunt rekenen op:

  • Een bruto maandsalaris van €4.487 tot €6.494, afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring.

  • Een mobiliteitsbudget van €850 per maand, vrij in te zetten op de manier die bij jou past.

  • Een fulltime dienstverband.

  • Flexibele werkmogelijkheden en ruimte om hybride te werken.

  • Veel zelfstandigheid en directe invloed op de ontwikkeling van de organisatie.

  • Ruime mogelijkheden voor persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling.

  • De kans om actief bij te dragen aan innovatieve AI- en automatiseringsprojecten.

  • Een informele en professionele werkomgeving met korte lijnen.

  • Een betrokken team van collega's dat samenwerkt aan verbetering en innovatie.

Waarom is dit een interessante functie?

Wat deze rol bijzonder maakt, is de combinatie van peoplemanagement, operationele verantwoordelijkheid en AI-innovatie.

Je krijgt niet alleen de opdracht om een bestaande supportorganisatie goed te laten functioneren, maar ook om deze klaar te maken voor de toekomst.

Daarbij krijg je de ruimte om processen structureel te verbeteren, nieuwe technologie toe te passen en daadwerkelijk invloed uit te oefenen op de manier waarop IT-dienstverlening wordt georganiseerd.

jobs.title: Senior Customer Support Advisor
jobs.description:
Location: Stoke-on-Trent ST1
Training Period: Will be conducted Monday to Friday, 9am to 6pm for the first four weeks
Working hours: 40 hours per week, 5 days out of any 7 (8 hours a day, between 7:50am - 2am)

Remuneration Package

  • Up to 20% annual company bonus and unsociable hours allowance, when applicable
  • Office-based for the first 4 months (probation and training period) - this will allow you to get to know the team, soak up crucial knowledge and benefit from face to face support whilst learning the role!
  • Hybrid working (2 days in the office) available after successful completion of probation period

The Role

Providing the best in class service to our players needs lots of work. Your energy and passion will be put to good use, and the more you give, the more you'll get in return.

LiveScore Group is home to LiveScore, LiveScore Bet and Virgin Bet, three of the most exciting brands in the sports and gaming industries today. We are passionate and excited about what we do in the Sports Media, Gaming and Betting sector and are proud of the high ratings we have achieved. We live our values, aiming to enhance and increase the enjoyment of sport through innovative products and immersive experiences. Trust is important in how we work, ensuring we are a collaborative unit who holds each other accountable. Relentlessly ambitious in everything we do, we embrace change and understand that failure is part of success.

We use our platform for positive social change and work to build a company our employees are proud to work for. We have a long-term commitment to diversity and inclusion. Our I.D.E.A (Inclusion, Diversity, Equality, Awareness) Forum is critical to our business and is embedded in our organisational structure to support a sense of belonging for everyone and to create a culture that allows all employees to thrive.

We know a job description can often deter an applicant who does not believe they match 100% of our requirements. If you are interested in this position and have relevant experience, then we would still love to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities

  •  Act as a first point of contact for our players providing them with a resolution to their sporting or gaming query. Sports betting happens quickly; in this role we will expect you to think fast and react even faster.
  • Try to resolve everything, first time, every time. With complex issues, you should ascertain urgency and follow the appropriate next steps in line with the department guidelines, escalating issues to the right department or Service Lead where appropriate.
  • Time is of the essence. You'd need to manage all tasks in an efficient and timely manner. If you follow the escalation procedure, keep track and see it through resolution, too.
  • Numbers are important. We need tip-top mathematicians to provide our players with transactional advice on banking, deposits, withdrawals, pricing and calculation of bet settlements.
  • The art of conversation. You'd need to communicate effectively and efficiently with players, colleagues, Service Leads and the Management Team to ensure delivery of business objectives.
  • Hit the spot. Our department KPIs need to be met (or exceeded) and so we ask that you're fast, efficient and that you get it right first time to thrill our players and reduce duplicate contacts.
  • Knowledge is power - Keep on top of sports, as well as our other products and tools, to ensure you're keeping up with our players, and with the business and department's strategy.
  • Collaborate with other departments, take part in projects, and attend meetings at other locations as required.
  • Have fun, making fun – Contribute to, and promote, a positive working environment.
  • Become a constant, positive role model and drive to inspire others to have fun whilst working.
  • Be proactive and demonstrate Real Time Resource Management awareness maintaining service levels and efficiencies.
  • Deflect Operator Complaints by handling 2nd line escalations and finding positive solutions.
  • Have a flexible attitude towards shift patterns.

Skills, Knowledge and Experience

  • A key understanding of the business and department OKRs with a determination to achieve and exceed targets.
  • A technical problem solver with a focus on helping develop internal functions.
  • An ability to bring outstanding issues to a resolution, building key relationships across the business.
  • Liaise with key stakeholders raising critical issues and reduce the customer propensity to contact.
  • To escalate and help guide company decisions through sharing voice of the player feedback.
  • A problem solver whilst showing commercial awareness for each player.
  • An expert in the group marketing initiatives and internal functions and processes.
  • To be able to resolve complex queries and show a commitment in helping guide the CS Advisor group. 
  • Maintain & exceed the internal QA score going above and beyond for each customer contact.
  • An expert in handling multiple Live Chat, email & social media
  • Outstanding customer handling skills, as well as oral and written communication skills
  • An investigative approach whilst fact-finding to guarantee first contact resolution
  • Excellent PC skills, who is an expert with Excel and the web.
  • Fast and accurate typing skills
  • Sports knowledge & a passion for sports is essential

What can we offer? 

  • Company Performance bonus
  • Hybrid working for all staff with flexible working opportunities
  • Private Healthcare scheme + Employee Enhanced Assistance
  • Enhanced Family Leave - Maternity, Shared Parental & Adoption Leave: up to 6 months at full pay and 6 months at half pay. Paternity leave: up to 4 weeks at full pay
  • Subsidised gym membership
  • Life Assurance (x3 salary)
  • Contributory Pension Plan
  • Daily snacks, quality coffee, soft drinks and regular socials

jobs.title: Senior Customer Solutions Engineer
jobs.description:
Life at Plume

At Plume, we believe that technology isn't about moving faster, it's about making life's moments better. Which is why we've built the world's first, and only, open and hardware-independent service delivery platform for smart homes, small businesses, enterprises, and beyond. Our SaaS platform uses WiFi, advanced AI, and machine learning to create the future of connected spaces—and human experiences—at massive scale.

We now deliver services to over 60 million locations globally and have managed over 3 billion devices on our platform. We're expanding rapidly, pioneering a new category, and we achieved our Series F funding in just four years. Our customers include many of the world's largest Internet Service Providers (ISPs) who look to Plume to help them evolve their smart home offerings while gleaning insights from their own data. 

With a bias for action and a love for being trailblazers, the team at Plume embodies a combination of relentless curiosity and imaginative innovation. We challenge ourselves to think in ways that other companies don't, work to do what should be done (rather than what can), and if we can't do it exceptionally well, we don't do it. It's how we've assembled a team of world-class builders, thinkers, and doers. And it's how we're reinventing what's possible every day.

Plume is seeking an experienced and highly motivated Senior Customer Solutions Engineer to join our dynamic team. As a key technical advisor, you'll work directly with Internet Service Providers (ISPs), acting as the bridge between their business needs and our cutting-edge solutions. You'll play a crucial role in the sales process, from initial discovery to successful deployment, ensuring our partners achieve maximum value from our products.
This is a fantastic opportunity for a technically adept individual with a passion for networking, cloud, and AI who thrives in a customer-facing role.

Responsibilities
  • Technical Trusted Advisor: Engage with ISPs to deeply understand their technical and business requirements, and then effectively demonstrate how Plume's solutions can meet and exceed those needs.
  • Product Demos & Trials: Conduct compelling product demonstrations and manage complex proof-of-concept (PoC) and field trials, showcasing the tangible benefits of Plume's technology.
  • System Integration: Collaborate with our internal Customer Engineering, Product Management, and Operational teams to understand and deliver Plume's solutions within a customer's ecosystem. You'll work to integrate our solutions into their existing BSS/OSS, CRM, ticketing, and AI platforms using APIs and other integration methods.
  • Sales Enablement: Work closely with the sales organization to drive revenue, achieve sales quotas, and contribute to the overall growth of the business.
  • Presentations & Events: Prepare and deliver high-impact presentations, including Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), and represent Plume at industry events and conferences.
  • Product Development Input: Provide valuable feedback to our product and engineering teams based on customer requirements and market trends, helping to inform the development of new features and solutions.
  • Technical Support: Offer prompt local and remote technical support for PoCs, lab trials, and deployment ramp-ups, ensuring a smooth and successful customer journey.
  • Industry Expertise: Continuously research and stay up-to-date on the latest industry standards and emerging technologies in networking, cloud architectures, and AI.
Experience & Qualifications
  • Hands-on Technical Experience: Strong hands-on experience in the configuration and deployment of software and hardware, including Wi-Fi, networking equipment, and cloud services. A fundamental understanding of cloud architectures and AI principles is essential. Deep understanding and knowledge of Residential and SMB Gateways is a big plus.
  • ISP SaaS Experience: Proven experience working with ISPs to deploy large-scale SaaS network solutions to millions of endpoints.
  • Communication & Collaboration: A track record of developing and maintaining professional, cooperative relationships with all levels of staff and customers.
  • Networking & Cloud Certifications: Relevant certifications such as CWNA, CCNA, or AWS Solutions Architect are highly preferred.
  • Problem-Solving: Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues in a fast-paced environment.
Qualification Requirements
  • Experience: 5+ years of related experience working with network, security, SaaS, and/or AI industries.
  • Education: A BS/BA degree in a relevant field or equivalent work experience.
  • Industry Knowledge: In-depth industry knowledge and a strong understanding of SDN and wireless technologies, solutions, and product offerings are preferred.
  • Communication Skills: Advanced written and oral communication skills.
  • Travel: Ability to travel >70% of the time.
Location/Language: This is a remote position. Candidates must be based in United Kingdom or Netherlands and be fluent in English.

About Plume

As the creator of the only open, hardware-independent, cloud-controlled experience platform for ISPs and their subscribers, Plume partners with over 400 ISP customers, including some of the world's largest such as Charter, Liberty Global, and J:COM. 

Using OpenSync, the most widely supported open-source, silicon-to-cloud framework for smart spaces, Plume's software-defined network allows ISPs to decouple their service offerings from hardware and rapidly curate and deliver new services over a multi-vendor, open-platform architecture.

We partner with over 300 clients in 40+ countries and counting. Our unique model drives creativity and efficiency, allowing us to deliver tailored solutions that resonate deeply with audiences.

Our AI solutions enhance efficiency, spark creativity, and drive insightful decision-making, empowering our teams to produce innovative and impactful results. 

E-commerce Data Analyst

Location: Weybridge, Surrey, United Kingdom

 

Established in 2004, Inside Ideas Group is a rapidly growing global agency network that helps clients drive their businesses forward from the inside. We partner with over 300 clients in more than 40 countries, delivering ideas, technology and creativity that make a measurable impact. 

As part of The Brandtech Group, we are pioneers in using advanced AI technologies to transform the way we create, optimise and deliver work. Our AI capabilities enhance efficiency, support smart decision making and unlock new levels of creativity for our teams and clients. 

We are now looking for a skilled Data Analyst to join our onsite team supporting in London. 

About the Role 

As the E-commerce Data Analyst, you will be responsible for delivering insight that drives improvements across the full commercial ecosystem spanning customer experience on, retailer investment effectiveness, marketing and sales performance, and the broader post-purchase, onboarding and promotional landscape. 

A core part of your remit will be the design, build and ongoing management of a marketing and sales performance dashboard, underpinned by Google BigQuery and delivered in Looker Studio. This will serve as a critical decision-making tool for marketing, e-commerce, retail and CX teams surfacing insight such as campaign uplift, halo effects, retailer investment impact and share performance across products and markets. 

Alongside this, you will analyse customer journeys, benchmark competitors, oversee content performance and support the planning and execution of onboarding and e-commerce promotions using platforms like GWI to create digital personas and audience profiles. 

You will collaborate closely with CX, marketing, product and e-commerce teams as well as HQ and local market stakeholders to ensure insight informs decisions at every stage. 

This role requires strong analytical capability, expertise in data modelling and SQL, and the ability to translate complex commercial questions into dashboard logic and actionable recommendations. 

What You Will Be Doing 

Marketing & Sales Performance Analytics  

  • Design, build and maintain a marketing and sales performance dashboard in Looker Studio, underpinned by BigQuery, combining sell-out sales data, market volume and share data, and campaign activity logs. 
  • Define the underlying data model, transform source files and design the reporting layer to support consistent, scalable KPI delivery. 
  • Identify and quantify the impact of retailer investment, including uplift in sales and market share during campaign periods. 
  • Analyse correlations between campaign activity and commercial performance to determine which marketing levers are most effective. 
  • Measure and report on halo effects across products and retailers resulting from promotional and campaign activity. 
  • Define and calculate key performance metrics including uplift, baseline, market share, activity intensity and halo effects. 
  • Work with GFK or other syndicated market data sources to enrich performance analysis with market volume and share context. 

Customer Experience & Digital Analytics 

  • Conduct analysis of the current customer experience, including user behaviour, content and campaign performance and conversion pathways. 
  • Benchmark key customer journeys against competitor websites to identify gaps and opportunities. 
  • Provide regular insight into paid promotions, post-purchase experience and customer satisfaction trends. 
  • Support planning, optimisation and operational management of post-purchase and onboarding experience. 
  • Analyse content utilisation, engagement and drop-off points, and recommend enhancements. 
  • Collaborate with HQ and local teams on onboarding content production and implementation. 
  • Support feature management including evaluation, testing performance and monitoring adoption, with ongoing analysis of content effectiveness and customer experience updates. 
  • Reporting, Dashboards & Stakeholder Insight 
  • Build and maintain dashboards, reports and ad hoc analyses across customer experience, onboarding, e-commerce, retail performance and promotion activity. 
  • Translate data into clear insights that guide decision-making within marketing, CX, digital and commercial teams. 
  • Present findings clearly to stakeholders at all levels, ensuring insight is embedded in planning and operational processes. 
  • Use platforms like GWI to build digital personas and audience profiles that support broader marketing planning. 

What You Need to Be Great in This Role 

Essential 

  • Proven experience as a data or insight analyst within digital, e-commerce, retail, marketing or agency environments. 
  • Strong proficiency in Google BigQuery and advanced SQL, including data modelling and reporting layer design. 
  • Hands-on experience building dashboards in Looker Studio, with a clear understanding of how to structure underlying data models for robust, scalable dashboard performance. 
  • Demonstrable experience combining sell-out sales, market share and campaign activity datasets to generate commercial insight. 
  • Ability to define and calculate metrics including uplift, baseline, market share, activity intensity and halo effects. 
  • Strong marketing analytics capability, including campaign effectiveness measurement across paid and promotional channels. 
  • Good understanding of digital customer journeys, content performance metrics and e-commerce KPIs. 
  • Experience with analytics platforms such as Google Analytics GA4, Adobe Analytics or similar. 
  • Excellent communication and storytelling ability — capable of translating complex business questions into dashboard logic and presenting findings clearly to non-technical audiences. 
  • Experience working with multi-market teams and managing stakeholder expectations across business functions. 
  • A passion for data-driven decision-making and an interest in how AI can enhance analytics workflows. 

Preferred: 

  • Proficiency in Python (pandas) for data transformation, automation and workflow scripting. 
  • Broader experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including automating data ingestion and transformation workflows. 
  • Experience working in retail, e-commerce or retailer media environments. 
  • Familiarity with GfK or other syndicated market data sources. 
  • Experience with additional BI tools such as Tableau or Power BI.

jobs.title: Senior Data Science Manager
jobs.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do.

Our EMEA Data Science organisation sits at the heart of Deliveroo and Wolt, powering decision-making across product, commercial and operational teams through experimentation, causal inference and deep business understanding. As part of DoorDash, our EMEA Data Science team brings together colleagues across Deliveroo and Wolt, creating opportunities to learn from different markets and tackle complex local-commerce challenges.

We're looking for a Senior Data Science Manager to shape data science strategy across a broad area of our Logistics organisation. You'll combine strong people leadership, technical judgement and commercial thinking to help our teams make better decisions and deliver measurable business impact.

About The Logistics Team

Logistics makes our marketplace work in the real world: connecting riders with orders and helping deliveries happen efficiently and reliably. The organisation works on problems such as predicting demand, improving delivery-time estimates, and matching orders with riders, all in an efficient way to ensure we can offer the most affordable pricing to our customers.

These are interconnected challenges. Decisions about supply, incentives and network efficiency can affect consumers, riders and restaurant and retail partners at the same time. Data Science helps us understand those relationships, test new approaches and balance delivery reliability, rider experience and sustainable business economics.

It's an environment where rigorous experimentation meets real-world complexity, and where your team's work can shape both everyday operational decisions and longer-term product strategy.

What You'll Be Doing 

You'll own the data science direction and measurable impact of a broad Logistics problem space spanning multiple cross-functional teams. You'll:

  • Set strategy and priorities with Product, Engineering and Operations leaders, focusing investment on the highest-impact opportunities across immediate needs and longer-term goals.
  • Build and develop a high-performing, inclusive team through hiring, coaching and performance management, growing leaders who can deliver independently.
  • Guide solutions to complex marketplace challenges, from balancing supply and demand to evaluating incentives and improving delivery performance and economics.
  • Set the technical bar for experimentation, causal inference and analysis, staying close enough to challenge approaches and ensure decisions reflect real marketplace effects.
  • Influence senior stakeholders and align teams around shared outcomes, resolving competing priorities and turning evidence into product and operational decisions.
  • Directly lead projects that resolve highly complex challenges, which often span across multiple parts of the business and unlock new vectors of impact, boosting company-level goals.

What You'll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate will bring:

  • A track record of leading and developing high-performing data science or closely related analytical teams, with responsibility for complex work spanning multiple teams or business areas.
  • Experience setting analytical strategy and allocating people and effort across competing priorities, with clear evidence of product, operational or commercial impact.
  • Strong technical foundations in experimentation, causal inference and statistical analysis, with the judgement to select appropriate methods, challenge conclusions and coach experienced practitioners.
  • The ability to reason about interconnected systems and trade-offs, including how an intervention in one part of a marketplace can affect outcomes elsewhere.
  • Experience influencing senior cross-functional leaders, aligning teams around shared goals and turning complex evidence into clear, actionable recommendations.
  • A thoughtful approach to building teams: hiring, coaching, managing performance and developing future technical and people leaders.
  • Comfort creating structure in ambiguous environments, making pragmatic decisions with incomplete information and adapting as new evidence emerges.

Experience developing other people managers would be particularly valuable. Experience in marketplaces, logistics, mobility, pricing, incentives or other operationally complex businesses is helpful, but not essential. We also value leaders who can bring relevant approaches from other domains.

You don't need to have worked on every problem listed here. We're interested in the depth of your leadership, the quality of your judgement and the impact you enable through others.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!


Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness.

jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst, ML & Experimentation (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. With our core product Playtime Arcade, we've become the global leader in rewarded advertising, an ad unit built on a simple premise: users earn real in-app rewards for engaging with new apps. The result is one of the most effective value exchanges in adtech, connecting advertisers and publishers with over 770 million users annually.

Architecting Intelligence to Optimize 200M+ Daily Decisions

As the intelligence core of our engineering organization, our Data Science team doesn't just deploy models, we engineer the fundamental decision engine that powers our platform. At a scale of 770 million users and 100,000+ predictions per second, we are solving a multi-objective optimization problem that balances user incentives, advertiser ROI, and long-term platform health in real time.

Our architecture is built on a 1PB+ behavioral data lake, providing the high-fidelity input necessary to train deep learning models that predict individual user engagement with precision. We aren't just optimizing clicks, we are dynamically calculating optimal reward structures to sustain a global value exchange.

Engineered for performance, our stack leverages PyTorch for model training, NVIDIA Triton to achieve sub-100ms inference. We own the full ML lifecycle from high-level research and feature engineering to deployment and A/B experimentation. Here, you will find the autonomy, the data depth, and the massive scale required to solve the most complex optimization challenges in the adtech ecosystem.

The data infrastructure behind this runs at real scale: 2TB ingested in real time every day, 100+ Airflow jobs and data pipelines, and ML models handling p99 latency of 100ms across 100,000+ predictions per second.

What you will do:

  • Analyze and evaluate the performance of our machine learning models using user-level and aggregated data, identify inefficiencies and failure patterns, and turn findings into actionable recommendations for our Data Science teams.

  • Define and improve metrics for measuring ML model performance and business impact, working closely with Data Scientists and Product Managers to ensure we optimize for the right outcomes.

  • Design, prepare and analyze A/B tests and other experiments to measure the impact of new models, features and algorithmic changes. Assess statistical significance, experiment quality and practical business impact.

  • Act as a strategic analytical partner to Product, Data Science, and Business leads. You proactively translate ambiguous business challenges into analytical roadmaps and turn complex ML insights into clear recommendations that shape product strategy.

  • Challenge product and technical decisions with data, bringing an independent analytical perspective to model development, experimentation and product strategy.

  • Drive analytical projects with end-to-end ownership: from initial scoping and hypothesis generation to stakeholder alignment and post-decision impact. Establish reusable frameworks and best practices that raise the bar for how we use data across teams.

  • Mentor and guide other analysts on the team, fostering a culture of high analytical standards, strong business intuition, and effective communication.

Who you are:

  • You have a degree in mathematics, statistics, physics, computer science, economics, analytics, or a similar quantitative field.

  • You have 5+ years of relevant experience in Data Analytics, Product Analytics, Experimentation, or Data Science, with a proven track record of delivering measurable business impact and working closely with senior cross-functional stakeholders.. Experience in AdTech, mobile apps or ML-driven products is a strong plus.

  • You’re proficient in SQL and comfortable working with large datasets.

  • You have strong Python skills and are comfortable using them for data analysis and statistical modelling.

  • You have a solid understanding of statistics and experimentation, including hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, statistical significance and A/B test analysis.

  • You have an understanding of machine learning concepts and model evaluation and are comfortable working with Data Scientists. You don't necessarily need to build ML models yourself, but you should understand how to assess their performance and limitations.

  • You have excellent data visualization skills and experience building dashboards using tools such as QuickSight, Power BI, Tableau, Streamlit or similar.

  • You can articulate complex algorithmic and behavioral insights clearly to non-technical stakeholders, align differing viewpoints, and comfortably present recommendations to leadership.

  • You thrive with ambiguity and have a high degree of ownership. You proactively identify high-value opportunities instead of waiting for tasks to be assigned, and you take pride in seeing initiatives through to real-world outcomes.

jobs.title: DevOps Engineering Intern
jobs.description:
About Sonio

Each year, 140M children are born. Birth defects affect 1 in 33 births in developed countries, and in 50% of cases, they are not detected during prenatal examinations. Prenatal medicine is particularly complex, and the scans impose heavy responsibilities on healthcare professionals. They can also be a source of stress for future parents.

Resulting from 5 years of collaboration between world-renowned experts from Necker Hospital and Ecole Polytechnique, Sonio uses artificial intelligence to improve prenatal screening and diagnosis. Based on patented algorithms and a proprietary expert database, Sonio aims to become the reference tool to help practitioners improve screening, reduce diagnostic errors, and optimize pregnant women’s medical path.

Sonio's mission is to improve women's and children's health by promoting access and quality of care through technological innovation, medical expertise, and collective intelligence.

About the role


We are looking for a DevOps / Platform Engineering intern to join our Platform team (DevOps, Data and Staff Engineers), which runs the infrastructure behind our SaaS platform. As the platform grows, so do our internal operational requests. Your mission will be to find out how far AI agents can take this RUN work off our plate, without giving up control.


Your main mission will be to:

  • Build an AI agent that turns internal infrastructure requests (provisioning a new service, managing AWS resources and access, environment variables or app configuration, Kubernetes or ArgoCD resources) into ready-to-review GitHub Pull Requests:

    1. Understand. The agent parses the request and picks the matching runbook.

    2. Generate. It produces the Terraform, Kubernetes or ArgoCD changes in our IaC repositories.

    3. Validate. It runs automated checks: tests, linting, and security and misconfiguration scans.

    4. Propose. It opens a traceable Pull Request for human review and approval.

  • Design the guardrails that make this safe: least-privilege access, approval steps, and predictable, repeatable runs. The AI never changes production on its own, and engineers stay in control of every change,

  • Deliver a working proof of concept on real internal requests, built so it can grow into a production-ready tool.

The AI never changes production on its own. Engineers stay in control, and every change is reviewed, tested and traceable.


Our infrastructure stack

  • Cloud: AWS, multi-region

  • Infrastructure as Code: Terraform

  • Containers & GitOps: Kubernetes on EKS, Helm, ArgoCD

  • CI/CD: GitHub Actions

  • Observability: Datadog

  • Security & Compliance: vulnerability and misconfiguration scanning, least-privilege IAM, and a HITRUST/SOC2-driven change process

  • Backend: Elixir/Phoenix

About the profile


Sonio is a mission-driven company so interest in our mission is critical. Other requirements are:

  • Currently in Master 2 / Bac+5 of Engineering School or University, you are majoring in Computer Science and are looking for an internship lasting between 5 and 6 months,

  • Good knowledge of AWS, Terraform, Kubernetes, and Git and CI/CD workflows,

  • Solid scripting skills (Python or similar) and a security-minded approach to infrastructure changes,

  • Strong interest in AI agents and LLMs applied to real engineering problems,

About HIVED 📦

At HIVED, we’re steamrolling forward as one of Europe’s fastest growing startups, and our momentum shows no signs of slowing.

Based in London, we are a climate and logistics start-up building the first sustainable parcel delivery network at scale, powered by a 100% electric fleet. In an ever-growing industry where unreliable service has long been the norm, HIVED has been built from the ground-up to meet the demands of modern consumers and disrupt parcel delivery.

A tech company at heart, our talent and technology is laser-focused on delivering the best possible delivery experience for end-customers and meeting the needs of our retail partners. From our drivers to our data engineers, we are constantly working to improve this customer experience that makes us deliver better.

Already trusted by leading international brands such as John Lewis, Nespresso, Uniqlo, H&M brands and more, we are solidifying our position as the leaders in Europe to tackle this growing market.

Our tight-knit team is made up of ex-Revolut, Bain, HelloFresh, ASOS, Apple and Google employees, and we are backed by some of Europe’s leading investors and VCs in climate-tech, logistics and mobility including Planet A Ventures, Maersk Growth, Pale Blue Dot VC, Eka Ventures, NordicNinja VC and the British government. We’re passionate about driving innovation and redefining the future of delivery.

 

Role Overview 📝

The Day Ops Manager is a critical role at our depots. As the Day Ops Manager, you are accountable for site performance during your shift—end-to-end across under-the-roof and on-the-road operations.

For on-the-road, you will manage and lead driver set-off in the morning while proactively supporting drivers and their service levels throughout the day. In the depot, you will oversee any daytime under-the-roof activities and bridges required from the previous day/week, as well as forward labour planning.

You will lead a team of Coordinators and you will need to have the highest standards of professionalism and discipline, leading by example in every moment. This is an on-site role embedded in the day-to-day operations.

 

What you’ll be doing 🚀

  • Lead shift during rotation - managing Shift Managers, Coordinators, Fleet Specialist - to deliver exceptional OTR & UTR day-time performance.

  • Receive handover from Night Manager, deliver handover to mid-Shift Manager.

  • Be the GM’s primary support & deliver strong handovers

  • Lead & inspire, & develop and performance manage, team on OM’s shift rotation.

  • OTR:

    • DSP management - DSP Capacity, Account management relationships, and performance management.

    • HIVED Partner Driver Capacity and pool management (Plan vs Actual).

    • HIVED Partner Driver service level management

    • Legal compliance (hours on road, breaks, safety checks).

  • UTR:

    • Labour planning for week-ahead & night.

    • Managing day activities, e.g. sortation as relevant, preparation for sortation.

  • Succession planning for week ahead + 6-week glance for their side of the week, & peaks.

  • Drives continuous improvement initiatives & Develop standards and operating procedures.

What you’ll be accountable for 🤝

  1. All on-road activities, including driver capacity, driver compliance, overall site performance (SLA, Delivery Success).

  2. All in-depot day-to-day and planning activities including people (labour pool, engagement, leadership succession planning), safety (auditing and near miss/incident reporting), quality (SLA, set-off/on-time dispatch), and cost (labour planning D+1/W+1/TPH).

What we’re looking for 🔎

  • 4-8 years’ experience leading fast-paced OTR / dispatch / last-mile operations.

  • Strong command of driver operations, route execution, and dispatch accuracy.

  • Hands-on shift leadership with ability to manage 30–100+ staff via supervisors. Ability to lead and coach team.

  • High urgency, strong communication, strong escalation habits.

  • Comfortable solving real-time operational pressure during peak windows.

  • Excellent cross-functional stakeholder management skills.

How we reward our team 🎁

  • Competitive market-related salary. Including the opportunity to work overtime when required.

  • 25 days of holiday allowance plus public holidays. If you're on on 4 days on, 3 days off shift pattern, you are entitled to the equivalent of 20 days paid holiday plus public holidays

  • 1 Birthday Day Off + 2 Tenure-Based Additional Days Off

  • Subsidised Private Medical Insurance including dental, vision & mental health therapy

  • Team lunch provided once a week

  • Quarterly team socials and annual sports day (HIVED Olympics)

  • Enhanced maternity/paternity/adoption policy as day 1 right

  • MacBook Air or Windows Laptop (depending on your preference)

  • Cycle to work scheme

Our Values

  • 😊 We Are Kind - We leave our egos at the door and aren't afraid to make difficult decisions. We must never confuse kindness with being "nice" - kindness requires us to be fair, consistent and work together to move HIVED forward.

  • 🤝 We Are Tenacious - We fight every day to keep the customer promise, for every parcel entrusted to us. No matter how hard it gets or whatever stands in our way, we are relentless in our pursuit of excellence.

  • 💡 We Are Curious - We never settle, constantly challenge convention and are never afraid to ask why. We believe there is always more to learn, always a better way, and that we're always only just getting started.

  • 💰 We Are Resourceful - Resources are scarce and our business depends on our ability to use resources wisely. Waste is the enemy. We strive to do more with less, be more efficient and make the most of what we have.

At HIVED, we’re steamrolling forward as one of Europe’s fastest growing startups, and our momentum shows no signs of slowing.

Based in London, we are a climate and logistics start-up building the first sustainable parcel delivery network at scale, powered by a 100% electric fleet. In an ever-growing industry where unreliable service has long been the norm, HIVED has been built from the ground-up to meet the demands of modern consumers and disrupt parcel delivery.

A tech company at heart, our talent and technology is laser-focused on delivering the best possible delivery experience for end-customers and meeting the needs of our retail partners. Already trusted by leading international brands such as John Lewis, Nespresso, Uniqlo, H&M brands and more, we are solidifying our position as the leaders in Europe to tackle this growing market.

Our tight-knit team is made up of ex-Revolut, Bain, HelloFresh, ASOS, Apple and Google employees, and we are backed by some of Europe’s leading investors and VCs in climate-tech, logistics and mobility including Planet A Ventures, Maersk Growth, Pale Blue Dot VC, Eka Ventures, NordicNinja VC and the British government. We’re passionate about driving innovation and redefining the future of delivery.

 


Role Overview 📝

We're looking for a Senior or Staff Engineer to take on some of the hardest problems at HIVED: the planning systems that decide how every parcel moves through our 100% electric delivery network.

You'll join the Routing Squad, which owns HIVED's entire planning pipeline: demand forecasting, capacity planning and scheduling, sortation, our collections network and large-scale route optimisation. Most of the work is backend engineering on distributed, production-grade systems, built in close partnership with data scientists, analysts and our operations teams. If your depth is in operations research or machine learning and you want to see your models plan a real delivery network every day, we'd love to hear from you too.

This is a hands-on role with a lot of technical ownership. You'll shape how the pieces of the pipeline fit together and your work shows up in the routes our drivers take, the cages filled at our depots and the parcels that arrive on time.

The problems are as varied as they are hard. How much volume will each depot see next week, and how many drivers and vehicles do we need to meet it? How should parcels flow through sortation and our collections network so nothing is handled twice? How do we turn each day's parcels into routes that are efficient, reliable and on time? And how do we model the cost and geography of our network as we expand into new cities?

 

What You'll be Doing 🚀

  • Build the planning pipeline. Design, build and run the distributed systems behind routing, capacity planning, sortation and our collections network.

  • Turn ambiguity into designs. Take complex operational problems, break them down, and see them through from first investigation to production.

  • Shape the architecture. Shape how the planning pipeline fits together, and coordinate with other squads where our systems meet theirs.

  • Put models into production. Build and productionise optimisation, forecasting and ML models, making them robust, observable and ready for peak volumes.

  • Stay close to the operation. Work directly with operations teams, see how plans perform on the ground, and close the loop with data.

  • Raise the bar. Lead design and code reviews, mentor engineers, and set the standards for testing and reliability.

 
 

What We're Looking For 🔎

  • Typically 5+ years of software engineering experience, building and operating production systems.

  • A track record of technical ownership beyond your own work: you've shaped the architecture or direction of systems spanning multiple components or teams.

  • The ability to translate complex, ambiguous operational problems into technical solutions with measurable impact.

  • Proficiency in Python or Go, or another language with the ability to ramp up quickly on HIVED's stack.

  • An appetite for hard optimisation problems: routing, scheduling, forecasting, supply-demand matching, or other constraint-heavy domains.

  • Strong collaboration and written communication skills, with the confidence to work across engineering, data science, analytics and operations.

You also bring depth in at least one of:

  • Backend and distributed systems: strong system design skills in distributed, production-grade environments, including event-driven architectures, cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred), and reliability and performance at scale.

  • Optimisation / operations research: linear and integer programming, constraint programming or heuristics, and integrating solvers such as OR-Tools or Gurobi into production systems.

  • Machine learning: forecasting and predictive models that feed planning decisions, from development to monitoring in production.

 


Technologies we use 💻

  • Python, Go

  • AWS (Lambda, ECS Fargate, Step Functions, SQS, EventBridge, Aurora PostgreSQL), CDK (TypeScript)

  • GCP, BigQuery, Looker

  • Grafana, Loki, Tempo, Prometheus

  • GitHub, GitHub Actions

  • Claude Code

  • Event-driven architecture and domain-driven design

 


Our interviewing process 🪜

  • Intro call with the hiring manager

  • Live coding challenge solving a problem

  • A take home case study, followed by a discussion

  • On-site interview at our Shoreditch HQ (role and culture)


Our Values

  • 😊 We Are Kind - Kind to the planet, our team and our partners. We listen with purpose, leave our egos at the door and aren't afraid to make difficult decisions. We must never confuse kindness with being "nice" - it requires us to be fair, consistent, honest, thoughtful and compassionate.

  • 🤝 We Are Tenacious - We fight every day to keep the customer promise, for every parcel entrusted to us. No matter how hard it gets or whatever stands in our way, we are relentless in our pursuit of excellence.

  • 💡 We Are Curious - We never settle, constantly challenge convention and are never afraid to ask why. We believe there is always more to learn, always a better way, and that we're always only just getting started. We never fight the urge to be inquisitive, to understand the world around us and to explore where others might not.

  • 🌍 We Are Resourceful - Our planet's resources are scarce and our future depends on our ability to use them wisely. Waste is the enemy. We strive to do more with less, be more efficient and make the most of what we have.

How we reward our team 🎁

  • Dynamic hybrid working environment with a diverse and driven team

  • Huge opportunity for learning in a high growth environment, with progression opportunities based on success in the role

  • 25 days of holiday allowance plus public holidays

  • 1 Birthday Day Off + 2 Tenure-Based Additional Days Off

  • Subsidised Private Medical Insurance including dental, vision & mental health therapy

  • Bi-annual performance reviews and tailored development plans

  • Competitive salary + EMI options scheme

  • Annual compensation review

  • Team lunch provided once a week

  • Quarterly team socials and annual sports day (HIVED Olympics)

  • Enhanced maternity/paternity/adoption policy as day 1 right

  • Community volunteer days

  • Cycle to work scheme

  • Dog friendly office and depots

  • MacBook Air or Windows Laptop (depending on your preference)

Le marché de la paie en cabinet d’expertise-comptable est dominé depuis des décennies par des solutions historiques. Chez Alassio, notre ambition est de rénover le métier au bénéfice des gestionnaires de paie, avec un logiciel moderne, évolutif et pensé pour les réalités du terrain.

Lancé en juillet 2025 et déployé en clientèle depuis mars 2026, Alassio accélère pour accompagner de nouveaux cabinets partout en France, tout en maintenant une exigence forte sur la qualité du produit et de l’accompagnement.

 

🎯 Pourquoi ce poste, maintenant

Pour accompagner cette accélération, nous cherchons un·e Account Executive Cabinets sur le périmètre Paris exclusivement, sans tournées régionales : un profil commercial qui aime prospecter, comprendre des enjeux métier exigeants et transformer une relation de confiance en signature.

 

🚀 Ton rôle

Tu développes ton portefeuille de cabinets en full cycle, de la prospection au closing. Tu es responsable de ton pipeline et de tes opportunités, avec l’appui des équipes Product, Tech, Déploiement et Accompagnement (DnA).

 

🧭 Tes missions

Prospecter et créer tes opportunités

  • Prendre en charge l’inbound de ton périmètre : qualifier les demandes, mener les découvertes, traiter les sollicitations avec réactivité et assurer des relances structurées

  • Identifier les cabinets à potentiel et construire une prospection ciblée via les canaux adaptés : online, événementiel, mises en relation et rencontres terrain

  • Combiner appels, emails, mises en relation et rendez-vous pour ouvrir de nouvelles conversations

Qualifier, démontrer et conclure

  • Comprendre l’organisation du cabinet, ses usages, ses irritants et ses enjeux de changement de logiciel de paie

  • Qualifier les besoins, les interlocuteurs, le processus de décision et le calendrier du projet

  • Préparer et mener des démonstrations adaptées, en mobilisant les expertises internes lorsque nécessaire

  • Piloter chaque étape du cycle : suivi des échanges, traitement des objections, proposition commerciale, négociation et closing

  • Maintenir un pipeline fiable, avec des prochaines étapes claires et des prévisions commerciales argumentées

  • Préparer une transmission fluide aux équipes Déploiement et Accompagnement (DnA) pour que les engagements pris pendant la vente soient compris et partagés

Développer une présence terrain sur ton périmètre

Organiser des rendez-vous dans les cabinets parisiens, rencontrer les décideurs et développer un réseau local de cabinets et de prescripteurs. Représenter Alassio lors de salons et d’événements du secteur comptable et social à Paris, puis assurer le suivi commercial des contacts. Articuler rendez-vous en présentiel et échanges à distance : les déplacements sont locaux, dans Paris uniquement.

Contribuer au quotidien de l’équipe

  • Participer aux points d’équipe, aux revues de pipeline et aux échanges de pratiques

  • Partager les objections, les signaux marché et les apprentissages utiles au collectif dans une organisation lean et product-led

  • Contribuer à l’amélioration des messages, des supports et des méthodes commerciales, sans perdre de vue tes objectifs principaux

 

🛠️ Une collaboration rapprochée avec la Tech et le Product

Chez Alassio, les Sales ne travaillent pas à distance du produit. Tu échanges régulièrement avec les équipes Tech et Product pour comprendre ce que nous construisons, préparer les démonstrations, éclaircir les cas d’usage et faire remonter les besoins du terrain avec précision.

Tu sais contextualiser les contraintes d’un cabinet, distinguer un besoin d’une demande de fonctionnalité et aligner ton discours commercial sur les capacités réelles du produit, sans promettre ce qui n’est pas validé.

 

🤖 Notre OS interne au quotidien

CRM, documentation partagée, IA et automatisations sont des leviers pour mieux prospecter, préparer tes rendez-vous et assurer ton suivi. Tu prends rapidement en main de nouveaux outils, documentes tes échanges, maintiens une information fiable et partages les pratiques qui rendent l’équipe plus efficace.

 
 

Profil recherché

 

🌱 Expérience

  • Au moins 5 ans d’expérience dans la vente full cycle en SaaS B2B, sur des cycles impliquant plusieurs interlocuteurs et du présentiel

  • Une autonomie de lead generation : tu sais créer tes opportunités et mener une prospection régulière, sans attendre qu’on t’alimente en leads

  • Une capacité à conduire une découverte approfondie, démontrer la valeur, assurer le suivi commercial et négocier jusqu’à la signature

  • Une connaissance de l’écosystème comptable ou de la paie est un plus ; l’anglais professionnel est apprécié

  • Des notions ou une expérience passée dans la vente indirecte sont un plus

 

🛠️ Compétences et outils

  • Une forte appétence pour la collaboration avec les équipes Tech et Product, au-delà de la simple remontée de demandes clients

  • Une grande agilité avec les outils numériques, l’IA et les automatisations, associée à une utilisation rigoureuse de notre OS interne. Tu comprends l’importance de la data pour une approche méthodique

  • Une curiosité réelle pour les métiers de la paie et les enjeux des cabinets, avec l’envie de monter en compétence sur un produit à forte profondeur métier

 

💎 Qualités

  • Autonomie, proactivité et esprit collectif : tu avances sur tes objectifs tout en contribuant à la vie de l’équipe

  • Le goût du terrain et l’envie de développer un portefeuille exclusivement parisien, avec des rencontres locales

  • Data-driven et pragmatique : nous prenons des décisions basées sur des métriques précises et métier

  • Clarté, curiosité et esprit de coopération pour travailler avec les équipes et les cabinets

 
 

Processus de sélection

1️⃣ Premier entretien avec Maxime, Head of Sales 1h

2️⃣ Business case à partir de situations réelles avec Tancrède (CEO), Alexandre (Déploiement & Accompagnement) et Maxime - en présentiel 📍

3️⃣ Approfondissement métier et motivations avec Alexandre (Partner Success) et Maxime 1h

4️⃣ Prises de références

5️⃣ Rencontre avec l’équipe dans nos bureaux, en présentiel 1h

 
 

Ce que nous offrons

 

👊 Une mission au contact du terrain et du produit

Un rôle commercial full cycle au contact des cabinets, du produit et de l’équipe, pour accompagner la croissance d’Alassio sur Paris exclusivement, sans tournées régionales.

 

🎁 Rémunération et avantages

  • 💰 Rémunération compétitive + BSPCE

  • 🏥 Mutuelle Alan

  • 🍽️ Carte Swile (tickets restaurant)

jobs.title: Founding Strategy & Operations
jobs.description:
Alassio recherche son (sa) prochain(e) Founding Strategy & Operations !

 
 

Missions

 

🏗️ Alassio en quelques mots

En France, la paie et le social comptent parmi les fonctions les plus réglementées qui soient. Entre inflation réglementaire et évolutions légales et conventionnelles incessantes, la conformité est devenue un véritable fardeau pour les cabinets de paie et les services RH :

  • ce fardeau les empêche de se consacrer à ce qui compte vraiment, le conseil et l'accompagnement des salariés, qui en subissent donc eux aussi le poids ;

  • c'est aussi l'un des métiers où l'attrition est la plus forte en France, notamment parce que 60 % du temps des gestionnaires de paie est encore consacré à de la saisie ou à de la relecture manuelle.

Pourtant, des solutions technologiques majeures existent : l'IA permet en particulier d'automatiser une très grande partie des tâches les plus pénibles et de valoriser les données sociales. Mais le secteur reste largement à l'écart de cette révolution, et le problème n'est pas seulement réglementaire : le marché était verrouillé par des éditeurs historiques vieillissants, difficiles à quitter faute d'alternative crédible et de moyens pour migrer efficacement. Là aussi, l'IA fait voler ces barrières en éclats et ouvre la voie à une vague d'innovation attendue depuis des décennies.

C'est pour y répondre qu'Alassio construit la plateforme de paie et de gestion RH moderne qui manquait à ce marché, au service des cabinets et de leurs clients TPE/PME. Notre ambition est de développer en un temps record :

  • une plateforme collaborative et ouverte, qui s'intègre nativement aux outils des cabinets et de leurs clients, respecte leurs habitudes de travail et fluidifie les échanges entre gestionnaires de paie et entreprises ;

  • l'automatisation de la tenue administrative : collecte des données, paramétrage des évolutions légales et des règles propres à chaque entreprise, génération automatique des rapports et formulaires, traçabilité juridique dynamique et en temps réel, etc. ;

  • la valorisation des données de paie et sociales, pour offrir un conseil social à 360° et enfin répondre efficacement à l'ensemble des attentes des salariés, qui se sont de surcroît largement amplifiées depuis le Covid : gestion contractuelle, pilotage de la masse salariale, avantages salariés, fidélisation des talents, mutuelle…

L'objectif : devenir le « People OS » sur lequel les cabinets et leurs clients TPE/PME s'appuient pour gérer l'intégralité de leurs problématiques paie et RH.

 

🚀 Tes responsabilités

Ta mission est de concevoir et faire vivre les systèmes de fonctionnement d'Alassio. Concrètement, tu identifies partout dans l'entreprise ce qui empêche les équipes de travailler à l'échelle (un process défaillant ou absent, un passage de relais flou, une information introuvable, une tâche répétitive que personne n'a pris le temps d'automatiser) et tu le résous de bout en bout : un diagnostic précis, puis un cahier des charges documenté et actionnable, puis l'accompagnement de sa mise en œuvre jusqu'à son adoption effective par les équipes. Une solution que personne n'utilise n'est pas une solution.

Tes leviers sont aussi bien managériaux (formalisme interne, rituels, répartition des responsabilités) que produit et techniques (modèle de données, outillage, automatisation des flux de travail), avec un parti pris constant : « Just build it ». Tu mettras en place, avec les équipes concernées, des solutions actionnables et des systèmes qui tournent.

 

🧭 Tes premiers chantiers

Pour te donner une idée concrète, voici le type de chantiers que tu pourrais mener dans tes six premiers mois :

  1. Bâtir un réseau national de formateurs et d'intégrateurs certifiés, pour permettre aux cabinets de se former partout en France sans saturer nos équipes à chaque pic de déploiement : modèle économique et tarification, maillage du territoire avec les Sales, parcours de certification et suivi qualité avec l'équipe DnA (Déploiement & Accompagnement), cadre contractuel, et circuit de remontée des demandes des cabinets vers le support et le Product. En bref, tu contribueras à mettre sur pied une place de marché d'intégrateurs et de formateurs Alassio.

  2. Fluidifier le parcours d'un cabinet, de la signature à la production : formaliser les passages de relais entre les squads Sales, DnA, Métier & Juridique et Tech (ce qui est transmis, dans quel outil, dans quel délai, et qui tranche en cas de blocage). Ce travail se traduit par la mise en place de workflows au sein de Bedrock, notre OS interne : il rend l'ensemble du contexte d'Alassio interrogeable et permet de transformer quasi instantanément une solution que tu as formalisée en gain concret pour toute l'équipe.

  3. Améliorer en profondeur, en coordination étroite avec l'AI Engineer, notre OS Bedrock pour en faire le réflexe par défaut de toutes les équipes : identifier les cas d'usage transverses à plus fort impact, structurer le contexte métier qui alimente l'OS, travailler sur l'hébergement et la dimension collaborative, mettre en place des workflows d'agents déclenchés par événement, tenir à jour le catalogue des commandes, et mettre en place le suivi qui mesure la performance et l'adoption.

 
 

Profil recherché

 

🌱 Expérience

  • Au moins 2 ans d'expérience dans des rôles opérationnels (GTM, Ops) ou en conseil en stratégie, idéalement avec une dimension technique, dans des contextes où tu as vu la structure d'une équipe évoluer vite (par exemple une scale-up, ou une refonte organisationnelle chez des clients en conseil)

  • Une compréhension fine des goulots d'étranglement organisationnels et informationnels qui ralentissent les entreprises à mesure qu'elles grandissent, et des transformations que l'IA est en train d'y opérer

  • Le goût des défis techniques et un esprit très analytique, sans perdre ton profil généraliste : tes expériences t'ont amené(e) à croiser les expertises, entre commercial et technique, produit et métier

 

💎 Qualités

  • Un goût pour l'optimisation et l'organisation : tu aimes que les choses soient claires, que l'information soit facile à mobiliser, propre et maintenable, et tu prends plaisir à produire vite des éléments actionnables

  • Un biais très fort pour l'action : tu repères les problèmes avant qu'on te les signale, et tu ne t'arrêtes jamais au diagnostic

  • Penser à l'échelle : tu conçois dès le départ des solutions capables d'encaisser des montées en charge ×10 ou ×100, tout en restant pragmatique sur ce qui compte à court et moyen terme

 
 

Processus de sélection

  1. Premier entretien avec Tancrède (CEO) : 45 min

  2. Étude de cas à partir de situations réelles, à dominante métier, avec Tancrède, Maxime (Head of Sales) et Alexandre (Responsable DnA) : 1 h30

  3. Étude de cas à partir de situations réelles, à dominante technique, avec Hector (COO) et Paul Rousseau (Founding SWE) : 1 h30

  4. Rencontre informelle de l'équipe dans nos bureaux, puis échange séparé avec les fondateurs

  5. Deux à troise prises de référence

 
 

Ce que nous offrons

 

👊 Une mission unique

Tu rejoins une aventure entrepreneuriale en plein passage à l'échelle, sur un marché verrouillé depuis des années. Notre conviction : les bons process libèrent les équipes, les mauvais les étouffent. Ton rôle est précisément de concevoir les premiers, pour que chaque équipe d'Alassio aille plus vite, avec l'ambition assumée de bâtir une référence en matière d'organisation nativement construite autour de l'IA.

Le poste a vocation à grandir avec l'entreprise : selon tes envies et ce que tu auras construit, il pourra évoluer vers la direction des opérations, la structuration d'une nouvelle fonction ou le lancement d'une nouvelle activité.

  • 💻 Matériel informatique haut de gamme (MacOS, écran incurvé)

Founding Product Engineer
London · £120K–£200K plus equity · Visa sponsorship available

The Mission

We are replacing the Management Consulting industry with software.

The $1 trillion consulting industry is powered by some of the world’s brightest minds, yet they remain trapped in manual, inefficient workflows: spreadsheet orchestration, slide-deck assembly, and fragmented data synthesis.

We proved it on ourselves first. Our advisory business serves six private equity funds across the UK, Europe and the US, and one Riplo consultant delivers an engagement that a tier-one firm staffs with a full team. The platform we built behind that work is now open to the world. Next, we are running the same playbook on a much bigger market: AI transformations for PE funds and the companies they own.

Our team comes from QuantumBlack/McKinsey, BCG, DeepMind, Hg Capital and KKR. Cherry Ventures, Blue Lion and the founders of QuantumBlack back us, with angels from OpenAI, McKinsey, BCG and Apple. We are nine people, and we are hiring one Founding Product Engineer.

The Challenge

As our Founding Product Engineer, your role is not just “writing code”. You will report directly to our CTO, and define the product DNA of the company. You will:

  • Build Beyond the Chatbot: Design multi-step agentic workflows that move past simple RAG and produce analysis a PE fund pays for.

  • Make Quality Measurable: “Good enough for a partner” is a hard standard to code against. Build the evals, harnesses and review checks that prove an agent’s output meets it.

  • Work Directly with Our Clients: Build AI use cases inside client organisations, alongside the people who use them. What you learn there shapes the core roadmap.

jobs.description:
About Riplo

Riplo is a VC-backed, AI-native advisory and technology firm serving private equity across the deal lifecycle. We combine deep diligence expertise, forward-deployed AI teams and our own AI platform to give PE funds and their portfolio companies sharper answers and working AI, faster. We are growing quickly, winning work with leading funds and expanding the team, and this hire is a key part of that next phase.

  • Advisory: thematic research, commercial due diligence (CDD), AI due diligence, AI value creation, AI build solutions and exit readiness.

  • Solutions: forward-deployed AI teams that turn AI value creation plans into working software and measured value inside portfolio companies.

  • Software: building the operating layer for consulting.

  • Clients: mid-market and large-cap PE funds and their portfolio companies across the UK, Europe and the US.

  • Operating model: flat and AI-leveraged. Senior people work directly on the programme, supported by AI rather than layers of juniors.

  • Team: a blend of DD consultants, PE portfolio operators, AI advisors and AI engineers, with advisory and engineering working side by side.

Our team and culture

AI is rewriting the rules of consulting and of how portfolio companies operate. Most advisory firms are waiting to see what happens. We decided to be the ones making it happen.

We are a small, senior team that moves fast, sets a high bar and genuinely enjoys building Riplo together. Every person here shapes what Riplo becomes.

We build side by side in the office 4–5 days a week, because the best ideas come from being in the room together. If you want to sit at the table with us, roll up your sleeves and build something that matters, we want to meet you.

AI Transformation Director, Solutions · London (in office 4–5 days a week) · Full-time

This is not a typical transformation role. You will be a key hire working side by side with our Founding Head of Solutions, leading embedded AI transformation programmes inside PE-backed portfolio companies, standing up and running their AI Transformation Office, and helping build Riplo's Solutions practice from the ground up.

You will own the programme from week 1: governance, roadmap, use-case selection and the path from first build to measured value. Most programmes start with a list of 100+ ideas; your job is to turn that into 5 to 6 quantified use cases with named owners, get the first live within 6 weeks, evidence value against a baseline, and hand over a running office to a permanent owner.

You will have the autonomy of a founder, the exposure of a partner, and the tools of an AI-native firm. Your work will show up directly in portfolio company P&Ls, in fund value creation plans, in our product and in how Riplo grows.

What you'll do

Lead AI transformation programmes

  • Stand up the client's AI Transformation Office: decision rights, delivery process, monthly AI SteerCo and executive sponsorship.

  • Build and own the AI roadmap for the next 6+ months, sequenced with the client's data and platform foundations.

  • Run the use-case staircase end to end: select by week 3 on value, readiness and sponsorship; specify the redesigned workflow by week 4; get working tools in front of real users by week 6; measure results against baseline.

  • Sequence builds so each one reuses the capability the last one created, making every later use case faster and cheaper.

  • Gate every build on a named business owner, a baseline, a funded run cost and a route into daily use, with monthly cost and value reporting to the SteerCo.

Drive adoption and capability

  • Own adoption, not just delivery: enablement strategy, training, stakeholder engagement and usage dashboards that move AI from experimentation to daily workflow.

  • Compress how client teams build software, embedding agentic practices from spec to release and coaching engineers through the change.

  • Build the client's own capability, with a plan to move at least half of AI engineering capacity in-house within 6 months.

  • Write the operating model, governance and roadmap for the permanent owner, overlap their first month and hand over a running office.

Lead forward-deployed teams

  • Lead embedded teams of AI architects, forward-deployed engineers and PE operators, keeping strategy and production code in one team.

  • Translate business problems into tractable AI solutions, bridging executives, domain experts and engineers.

  • Present progress and evidenced value to portfolio company leadership, operating partners and deal teams.

Build the practice

  • Scope and write proposals and RFP responses, and support pitches to new and existing funds.

  • Turn each programme into reusable playbooks, assets and platform features that make the next transformation faster than the last.

  • Produce thought leadership on AI value creation (sector notes, case studies, LinkedIn content).

  • Build relationships with operating partners, portfolio company executives and technology partners.

What you'll bring

  • 3+ years across strategy consulting, PE value creation and enterprise AI or software delivery, including time at a top-tier consultancy, an enterprise AI vendor or in a PE-backed operating role.

  • A track record of leading AI or digital transformation at enterprise or portfolio company scale, from strategy through to adopted, production systems.

  • Measurable outcomes you can point to: adoption moved from near zero to the majority of a workforce, products shipped, or value evidenced against a baseline.

  • C-suite and investor credibility: you have aligned CEOs, CFOs, operating partners and technology leaders around priorities, funding and trade-offs.

  • Hands-on technical depth: you understand LLMs, agentic tooling, data platforms and the software development lifecycle well enough to lead architects and engineers, and you have built with them yourself.

  • Commercial judgment: you tie every AI initiative to productivity, revenue or enterprise value, and you have owned presales, proposals or a P&L.

  • Proven leadership of cross-functional teams of data scientists, engineers and solution architects under tight timelines.

  • AI fluency: you already use AI tools daily and can show how they make your work faster and better.

Who you are

  • Founder mindset: this is your business to own and grow. You treat Riplo's success as your own.

  • Outcome-obsessed: you measure success in adoption and evidenced value, not decks delivered or tools launched.

  • Proactive: you see what needs doing and do it before being asked.

  • Builder: you would rather ship a working tool in week 6 than perfect a strategy in week 12.

  • Ownership mindset: you take initiatives from idea to delivery and own outcomes, not just tasks.

  • AI-first: you look for the AI-enabled way to do every step, and keep refining it.

  • Calm under pressure: you lead with clarity when timelines are tight, stakeholders disagree and the path is ambiguous.

  • Comfortable with ambiguity: you thrive in a small, fast-moving team without rigid structure.

Why Riplo

  • Build something from the ground up: join early and help define what AI-native transformation looks like for private equity.

  • Real impact, fast: your programmes move portfolio company P&Ls and feed directly into fund value creation plans.

  • Senior from day one: lead client SteerCos, shape proposals and own executive and fund relationships.

  • Work at the frontier: lead our own AI engineers and platform inside client businesses, not just talk about AI.

  • Grow with the firm: a clear path to take on more as Riplo's Solutions practice scales.

  • Competitive package: salary, bonus and equity (details discussed at interview).
