jobs.title: Senior Product Designer
jobs.description:
In just over two years, we’ve gone from 0 to over 900 customers, succeeding where many have tried and failed before. We have a big mission: to make it wildly easier and more profitable to run and grow a renewables installation business – and through that to make a massive dent in the world’s carbon emissions and create a hugely better experience for homeowners.

We’re now looking for a stellar Product Designer who’s buzzing to create exceptional experiences for installers as we expand into new markets.

🌲 About Spruce

  • Almost 20% of the UK’s carbon emissions comes from heating homes – there’s simply no way to reach net zero without phasing out gas and oil boilers. Right now the only serious alternative is heat pumps, with their almost-magical ability to turn 1 kW of electricity into 3-5 kW of heat (🤯). But the heat pump installation journey is slow, inefficient, and just so painful. This makes it hard for existing installers to grow their businesses and puts off gas engineers from starting to do heat pumps. Perhaps most critically, it means you can’t currently offer a heat pump when someone’s boiler breaks and they urgently need heating.

  • We’re fixing this. We’ve built a platform for heat pump installers to manage the whole installation journey from initial enquiry through to final compliance paperwork, freeing up their time to focus on what really matters: doing high-quality installations, providing great customer service, and scaling their business. Despite only getting started at the beginning of 2024, we’re having a massive impact on installation businesses, suppliers, and manufacturers across the UK: halving the time they spend on each job and doubling their sales conversion rates.

  • We raised a chunky Seed round last year from top-tier investors and have been scaling the team to massively grow our impact. We’re in the process of expanding outside heat pumps and by the end of the year will be an operating system for the whole home renewables supply chain. If you can picture a combination of ServiceTitan, Procore, and autoCAD, you might get a sense of where we’re headed…

🥖 The Role

You’ll be central to our mission as we turn historically slow and painful processes into ones that are quick, intuitive and even delightful for installers. We’ve been design-led since the beginning but the challenge is only growing as our product becomes (necessarily) more complex. Day-to-day you’ll be:

  • Making complex decisions feel effortless – Our platform handles everything from building physics calculations to fluid dynamics modelling to complicated compliance requirements. We need to make handling that complexity feel effortless for all our customers, irrespective of how tech-savvy they are.

  • Designing across multiple touchpoints – You'll work on desktop design tools, homeowner-facing outputs, enquiry flows, mobile survey apps (incl LiDAR), and collaborative workflows that work seamlessly across different user types (from 3-person local installers to national utilities);

  • Collaborating closely with developers & shipping code yourself – Understanding data structures and technical constraints so your designs can be shipped quickly; and shipping PRs yourself when it makes sense (with the support of the dev team);

  • Building systematic, scalable design systems – Creating robust, structured, and reusable components that work across platforms and for potentially low-tech users;

  • Researching and validating - Interviewing and spending time with installers to deeply understand how they work and what the core problems to solve are; and building quick prototypes to test and validate design decisions and uncover unexpected pain points.

You'll report directly to Steph, our Co-Founder and CPO.

🫵 About You

We’re looking for a designer with 3+ years of product/UI design experience (and potentially a lot more), ideally in a startup context or within fast-paced, impact-focussed teams. We'd love to speak with you if you are:

  • A clear, systematic thinker who loves tackling complex flows;

  • Comfortable with diving into technical detail, even if it’s a new domain;

  • User-obsessed; you enjoy deeply understanding the user, solving their problems and making a tangible impact on them;

  • Great with people and confident running research with customers;

  • Proactive and self-organising, happy juggling multiple projects;

Bonus if you’ve worked on tools for field teams, low-tech users, or on operational workflows (but absolutely not a requirement!).

🌟 Our offer

  • 💰 £70-100k salary, depending on experience.

  • 🍰 Meaningful slice of equity (options) in the company

  • 🏖️ 33 days holiday and opportunity to work from abroad for another 30 days each year

  • 🏡 Hybrid working: 2–3 days in-person a week (London or Bristol), with full-team meetups every fortnight

  • 🏥 Private Medical Cover

  • 👧 Workplace Nursery Benefit scheme (YellowNest)

  • 🧑‍🍼 Enhanced Parental Leave

  • 🚲 Cycle to Work scheme

  • 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Brilliant team to learn from and massive opportunity to grow

🧑‍💻 Working at Spruce

  • We’re currently a close-knit team of 32, split between London and Bristol. We spend 2-3 days each week working together in-person in both locations, and get everyone altogether every fortnight.

  • You'll have genuine influence from day one. The best idea wins regardless of seniority. We expect you to challenge everything, ask "why?" multiple levels deep, and push back when something doesn't make sense.

  • We want everyone to spend time with installers on-site, feel their pain points, then be able to rapidly suggest and implement solutions based on real feedback rather than assumptions. This is clearly particularly important for this role but you’ll be surrounded by a whole team who are also close to our customers.

  • We move fast and ship imperfect things, learning from users rather than trying to perfect in isolation. When things break, we focus on how we fix it, what can we learn and never blame. You'll own your outcomes whilst knowing the team has your back.

  • Feedback is constant, direct, and kind – we'll tell you when something isn't working and expect the same honesty (and empathy) back.

Compensation: £70K – £100K • Offers Equity

jobs.description:
About Fluidstack

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.


We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

How We Operate

  • Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

  • Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

  • Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

  • Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

  • Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

The Production Engineering Team

Examples of key exciting problems the team is working on

  • Turn every network fault from a mystery into a closed ticket: link diagnostics across router-router and NIC-to-router paths, remote command execution across the fleet, and repair visualization that shows exactly what's broken and why. At this scale, debugging has to be systematic, not artisanal.

  • Build the network repair pipeline that runs itself: from automated fault detection through RMA initiation, ticket integration, transceiver lifecycle tracking, and return to service, across DC fabric, edge, and host-to-network layers. When a new site comes online every six months, manual repair doesn't keep up.

  • Build the network monitoring platform for a fleet that never stops growing: define requirements, alerting lifecycle, and health dashboards from scratch, for infrastructure spanning multiple hyperscale sites today and 10s to 100s of GWs ahead. It doesn't exist yet. We're building it.

Role Scope

  • Own network fleet health end to end. Define the realtime monitoring requirements, build the alerting lifecycle, and ship the dashboards that give every on-call engineer a true picture of network state across all sites.

  • Build active debugging tooling. Link diagnostics, remote command execution across the fleet, and repair visualization — the tools that turn a network fault from a mystery into a solvable problem, fast.

  • Turn repair into a pipeline, not a procedure. Build the automation that takes a network failure from detection through parts management and return to service. Ticket integration, repair lifecycle pipelines, transceiver and optics tracking — owned, not improvised.

  • Own network qualification and validation. Build the frameworks that gate new sites and hardware into production. You define what a healthy network looks like before it carries traffic.

  • Own end-to-end reliability, scalability, and operation of the network at-scale. Fluidstack is building one of the largest datacenter networks in the world and that can only be accomplished with aggressive automation, tooling, and incident discipline.

What We're Looking For

The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly, tell us where you would.

  • You treat toil as a bug. If diagnosing a link failure requires SSHing into boxes and running commands by hand, you build the tool that does it for you.

  • You think in systems. You understand how a transceiver fault, a misconfigured route, and a power event each propagate differently — and you build tooling that can tell them apart.

  • You move toward ambiguity, not away from it. You walk into the fog, build the map, and explain it to everyone else.

  • You learn at a steep slope. You reach real competence in an unfamiliar domain fast. We value this over existing expertise.

  • You carry a pager without flinching. You run the incident, write the postmortem, fix the systemic cause, and move on.

  • You're fluent with AI tooling. LLM APIs, MCP servers, and agentic frameworks, and you drive Claude Code, Cursor, or similar every day.

  • You've shipped production network tooling or automation that other teams depend on, and you're comfortable in any language using AI coding tools.

  • You’ve developed automation tools in Go and Python, are experienced in link diagnostics, optical networks, and understanding network monitoring (gNMI, gRPC, NETCONF, SONiC)

  • Bonus: RMA and repair lifecycle automation. Large-scale datacenter fabric (BGP, ECMP, spine-leaf). Out-of-band network management.

Salary & Benefits

  • Competitive total compensation package (salary + equity).

  • Retirement or pension plan, in line with local norms.

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance.

  • Generous PTO policy, in line with local norms.

We are committed to pay equity and transparency.

As a Technical Analyst, you are the critical link between our clients' ambitions and Kaluza's cutting-edge SaaS platform. jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer - Search & Recommendation - Patient Team (x/f/m)
jobs.description:
Join our mission, join Doctolib! 

We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to join the Patient team in Paris. 

The Patient domain sits at the heart of Doctolib's mission: ensuring everyone has better access to the care they need, receives better care from health professionals, and can actively prevent health problems to improve their wellbeing.

You’ll design the search and recommendation engines behind our health companion, helping 100M patients across Europe instantly navigate to the exact care they need while delivering trusted, curated insights at every step. The retrieval and recommendation architecture you own will directly shape how relevant, fast, and trustworthy that experience is for every one of them.


Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Design and build the production search & recommendation architecture: full retrieval, ranking, reranking pipeline with standard and off-the-shelf components (vector search, semantic retrieval, LLM/managed rerankers).

  • Establish strong baselines first (prompts, RAG, model selection) before reaching for custom ML.

  • Build evaluation and observability into every stage, with offline and online evaluation.

  • Set up the data/event feedback loops that drive iteration and feed deeper ML later.

  • Improve search relevance and ranking on Patient facing products , raising result quality

  • Own production quality: latency reliability, monitoring, and maintainability.

  • Partner with ML Engineers and collaborate closely with PMs and SWEs to define, build, and ship AI-powered features that deliver measurable value to users and the business. 


Who you are

Before you read on:  if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.

You could be our next team mate if you have:

  1. Production deployment: ability to ship algorithms to production (ECS-based service on AWS)

  2. Strong analytical mindset: result-oriented,  patient-first approach

  3. Significant experience as a Software or/and AI engineer shipping search or recommendation systems to production. 

  4. Hands-on experience building end-to-end retrieval: ranking,  reranking pipelines and familiar with nDCG, MAP, Recall@k, MRR

  5. AI-engineering proficiency: turning foundation models and off-the-shelf components into production systems: embeddings & vector search, semantic retrieval, RAG, LLM-based or managed rerankers (e.g. Vertex AI). You can succeed without training a model from scratch

  6. Architecture-first approach: you build the system, baselines, evals, and feedback loops with standard tooling before reaching for custom ML, and know when to partner with ML Engineers to break a ceiling

  7. Evaluation & observability built into every stage (retrieval, ranker, reranker) — offline and online eval, A/B testing, position-bias handling, monitoring

  8. Production deployment — ability to ship reliable, low-latency services to production (hundreds-of-ms SLAs), with care for data quality and long-term maintainability

 

Now, it would be fantastic if you:

  • Experience at a B2C marketplace (e-commerce, hospitality, travel)

  • Additional ML methodologies: pattern mining, recommendation systems, experimentation, or causal inference

  • Have experience with search engines or information retrieval concepts

  • Have exposure to learning-to-rank or feature engineering (for breaking ceilings later, alongside ML Engineers)

  • Have experience in a healthcare or other regulated domain (GDPR / HDS)

Life at Doctolib Tech

  • Our solutions are built on a single, fully cloud-native platform that supports web and mobile app interfaces, multiple languages, and is adapted to country and healthcare specialty requirements.

  • Our stack is composed of Rails, TypeScript, Java, Python, Kotlin, Swift, and React Native.

  • We leverage AI ethically across our products to empower patients and health professionals. Discover our AI vision here.

  • We also invest in open, applied AI research. For example, our DoctoBERT project introduces open-source medical language models trained for French clinical text, with applications in named entity recognition, classification, and retrieval. Read the DoctoBERT practical guide to learn more about how we bring deep AI research into practical healthcare applications.

Want to learn more about our tech culture and environment? Visit the Doctolib Tech site.

What we offer

  • Free comprehensive health insurance (basic package) for you and your children

  • 25 days of paid vacation per year, plus up to 14 days of RTT

  • Free mental health and coaching services through our partner Moka.care

  • Work from abroad for up to 10 days per year thanks to our flexibility days policy

  • Lunch vouchers (Swile card) worth €8.50 per working day, with €4.50 covered by Doctolib

Software Engineering Intern - Fullstack (x/f/m)

Set a new pulse for healthcare!

We are looking for a Software Engineering Intern to join the Engineering team.

Your mission will be to build innovative products and features that improve the daily lives of care teams and patients. You will work in a feature team developing solutions that directly impact healthcare professionals and patients across Europe, contributing to our Operating System powered by AI to manage all clinical and administrative activities.

Working in the tech team at Doctolib means building innovative products and features to improve the daily lives of care teams and patients.

What you'll do

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Build and own features alongside experienced engineers — from design and development to testing and shipping — with a direct impact on real users

  • Collaborate with engineers, product managers, and designers to solve complex technical challenges and build scalable, secure, and user-friendly healthcare tools

  • Write clean, efficient code following industry best practices in design, testing, and peer review

  • Solve real-world problems that directly enhance patient care and improve doctor-patient relationships

  • Explore new tools and technologies, including AI and distributed systems, as part of your continuous growth

  • Contribute to a culture of learning and collaboration by sharing knowledge and engaging actively with your team

Who you are

Before you read on: if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.

You'll be a great fit if you:

  • You love problem-solving and are driven by curiosity — you're not afraid to dive into complex issues and find creative solutions

  • You thrive in a collaborative environment and enjoy working with cross-functional teams, sharing knowledge, and learning from your peers

  • You have a passion for technology and product development, and always keep the user experience in mind

  • You are comfortable coding, with the help of AI agents like Claude Code, in multiple languages and eager to learn our tech stack

  • You are in your final year of a degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field and looking for a 6-month full-time internship

  • Eager to learn and work in a team of builders

  • You are fluent in English

It would be fantastic if you:

  • Have experience with web development or building products in a fast-paced environment

  • Have worked on side projects or contributed to open-source communities

  • Are familiar with AI-assisted coding tools and eager to integrate them into your daily workflow.

Life at Doctolib Tech

  • Our solutions are built on a single fully cloud-native platform that supports web and mobile app interfaces, multiple languages, and is adapted to country and healthcare specialty requirements.

  • Our stack is composed of Rails, TypeScript, Java, Python, Kotlin, Swift, and React Native.

  • We leverage AI ethically across our products to empower patients and health professionals. Discover our AI vision here.

Want to learn more about our tech culture and environment? Visit the Doctolib Tech site.

What we offer

  • Tech masterclasses throughout the internship

  • Free breakfast at the office

  • Access to the best AI tools for coding and development, along with dedicated training

  • Discounted membership to Urban Sports Club

  • Meal vouchers worth €8.50 per day, with €4.50 covered by Doctolib

  • 50% reimbursement of public transportation subscriptions

  • Comprehensive health insurance, fully covered by Doctolib for employees and their children under the basic plan

  • Free mental health and personalised coaching programme with our partner, Moka.care

  • A comprehensive three-month onboarding programme, including Doctolib Academy and various training courses in languages, soft skills, and technical skills

  • A works council subsidy providing partial reimbursement for sports or leisure activity memberships

  • For employees with disabilities or caregiving responsibilities, a support package including adapted remote-working arrangements, paid authorised leave for medical appointments, and enhanced psychological support

Our interview process

  • Coding Game (1h)

  • Recruiter Interview (30 minutes)

  • Feature Building Interview (1h)

  • Behavioral Interview (1h)

Job details

  • Internship (6 months)

  • Niort

  • Hybrid work setup (up to 2 remote days per week)

  • Start date: March 2027

We welcome everyone

At Doctolib, we are committed to improving access to healthcare for everyone. This translates into our recruitment process. We evaluate candidates based solely on qualifications and motivation, without any form of discrimination.

The more diverse ideas are heard, the more our product will truly improve healthcare for all. You are welcome to apply to Doctolib, regardless of your gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, or disability.

To ensure equal opportunities, we invite you to exclude personal information (e.g., pictures, age) from your applications. If you require any accommodation, please let us know for support during the hiring process.

Join us in building the healthcare we all dream of!

Your data privacy

All information provided is processed by Doctolib for application management.

Please contact hr.dataprivacy(at)doctolib.com for inquiries or to exercise your rights.

jobs.title: AI Researcher - Pre-training (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Our Mission
Aleph Alpha is one of the few companies in Europe doing serious foundation model pre-training like our recently released Kolibri-1 model. Our customers - in finance, manufacturing, public administration - need models that understand German, meet European regulatory requirements, and work reliably in high-stakes settings. We're building that in Heidelberg.

We are hiring an AI Researcher (f/m/d) to join our Pre-training team and help advance the architecture and training of our next generation of foundation models. If you are excited about how large models learn, want to run experiments that feed directly into production training runs, and want hands-on time on large-scale clusters (thousands of NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs), we would love to hear from you.

Team Culture
We foster a culture built on ownership, autonomy, and empowerment. Teams and individual contributors are trusted to take responsibility for their work and drive meaningful impact. We maintain a flat organizational structure with efficient, supportive management that enables quick decision-making, open communication, and a strong sense of shared purpose. We collaborate closely on complex technical problems, working in pairs or using mob programming to resolve challenging issues. New team members learn through real work: from your first weeks you will pair with experienced researchers on live problems, and take on more ownership as you grow into it.

About the Role
As an AI Researcher in Pre-training (f/m/d), you will work on the technical levers that determine the success of our next-generation models: architecture, optimization, stability, and scaling.

Working at the intersection of research and engineering, you will learn to translate mathematical reasoning and empirical observations into principled training decisions, from small-scale proxy experiments to multi-thousand-GPU runs. You will start with well-scoped problems alongside senior researchers and progressively take ownership of larger parts of the training recipe.

We are looking for someone with strong fundamentals, sharp experimental instincts, exceptional skills, and the drive to go deep fast. You learn as much from a failed run as from a paper, you write code others can build on, and you want to become an expert in large-scale pre-training.

Your Responsibilities

  • Recipe & Architecture Experiments: Design and run ablations on core elements of the training recipe (optimizers, schedules, initialization), and implement PyTorch-based architectural changes. Evaluate their effect on convergence, stability, and training efficiency.

  • Scaling Experiments: Run and analyze small-scale proxy experiments, and contribute to the hyperparameter scaling laws and scale-up methods we use to predict behavior at multi-thousand-GPU scale.

  • Run Monitoring & Debugging: Help monitor large-scale training runs and investigate convergence issues such as loss spikes and divergence. Work with the team to track down distributed training failures.

  • Research to Practice: Follow the literature, reproduce promising results at small scale, and bring ideas worth testing to the team.

  • Cross-Team Collaboration: Work with the Compute Performance, Data, Evaluation, and Post-Training teams to understand how hardware constraints and the rest of the model lifecycle shape pre-training decisions.

Core Qualifications

  • You are proficient in Python and have hands-on experience with PyTorch.

  • You have a strong foundation in machine learning, shown through research (e.g., a PhD, a strong MS'c thesis, or publications), open-source contributions, or substantial professional or substantial personal projects.

  • You have a solid mathematical background (linear algebra, probability, optimization) and enjoy reasoning formally about why models train the way they do.

  • You understand how transformers work and have pre-trained LLMs from scratch yourself, even at small scale.

  • You design experiments carefully, report noisy and negative results honestly, and can explain clearly what your evidence does and does not show.

  • You have a track record of picking up unfamiliar technical areas quickly and going deep, for example by reimplementing papers, ramping up on a large new codebase, or debugging a problem well outside your comfort zone.

  • You write clean, maintainable code and care about reproducible experiments.

  • You communicate clearly, raise problems early, and actively seek out and act on feedback.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Distributed Training: Experience training models on multi-GPU or multi-node setups, or familiarity with distributed frameworks (e.g., Megatron-LM, DeepSpeed, torchtitan) and parallelism strategies (data, tensor, pipeline, expert).

  • Training Dynamics: Familiarity with scaling laws, hyperparameter transfer (e.g., µP), or recent work on optimizers and training stability.

  • Efficient Architectures: Exposure to Mixture-of-Experts, efficient attention variants, or other inference-efficient designs.

  • Research Output: Publications at top-tier venues (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR) or contributions to open-source ML training libraries.

  • Systems Curiosity: Low-level kernel optimization is not required, but we highly value a strong curiosity about the hardware and systems constraints that shape scale.

jobs.title: Senior AI Researcher- Pre-training (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Our Mission

Aleph Alpha is one of the few companies in Europe doing serious foundation model pre-training like our recently released Kolibri-1 model. Our customers - in finance, manufacturing, public administration - need models that understand German, meet European regulatory requirements, and work reliably in high-stakes settings. We're building that in Heidelberg.

We are hiring a Senior AI Researcher to join our Pre-training team and to advance the architecture and training of our next generation of foundation models. If you are excited about designing inference-efficient architectures, optimizing training recipes that scale reliably, and training models on a large scale cluster (thousands of NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs), we would love to hear from you.

Team Culture

We foster a culture built on ownership, autonomy, and empowerment. Teams and individual contributors are trusted to take responsibility for their work and drive meaningful impact. We maintain a flat organisational structure with efficient, supportive management that enables quick decision-making, open communication, and a strong sense of shared purpose. We collaborate closely on complex technical problems, working in pairs or using mob programming to resolve challenging issues.

About the Role

As a Senior AI Researcher in Pre-training (f/m/d), you will own the critical technical levers that determine the success of our next-generation models: architecture, optimization, stability, and scaling.

Working at the high-leverage intersection of research and engineering, you will translate mathematical reasoning and empirical observations into principled training decisions - from small-scale proxy experiments to multi-thousand-GPU runs.

We are looking for an expert who can combine rigorous experimental design with high-quality production code, directly influencing model quality, run reliability, and the efficiency of the models we ship.

Your Responsibilities

  • Recipe & Architecture Optimization: Own core elements of the training recipe (optimizers, schedules, initialization) and design PyTorch-based architectural improvements to maximize convergence, stability, and training efficiency.

  • Scaling Strategy & Predictability: Develop hyperparameter scaling laws and scale-up methodologies, using small-scale proxy experiments to reliably predict multi-thousand-GPU behavior and de-risk major training decisions.

  • Stability, Diagnostics & Debugging: Investigate complex convergence issues (loss spikes, divergence) and resolve hard-to-reproduce distributed system failures like communication bottlenecks, race conditions, and synchronization errors.

  • System-Model Co-Design: Partner with Compute Performance, Data, Evaluation, and Post-Training teams to align the model lifecycle with hardware constraints, memory bandwidth, and communication topologies.

Core Qualifications

  • You are proficient in Python and deeply familiar with PyTorch-based training workflows.

  • You have a strong track record in machine learning research and software engineering, demonstrated through shipped models, impactful open-source contributions, or published research.

  • You have a strong mathematical foundation and are comfortable reasoning formally about optimisation, scaling behaviour, and training dynamics.

  • You deeply understand transformer training dynamics, optimisation, and the behaviour of large distributed training jobs.

  • You can design rigorous experiments, reason clearly from noisy results, and translate empirical observations into robust training decisions.

  • Hands-on experience pre-training large models (e.g., 7B+ parameters) on substantial infrastructure (e.g., 100+ GPU clusters).

  • You apply strong software engineering practices, including writing maintainable, well-tested code and supporting reproducible experimentation workflows.

  • You are able to implement complex model architectures efficiently and reliably and to debug complex issues across model code, training dynamics, and distributed systems.

  • You collaborate effectively within a research and engineering team and communicate clearly about your work across Pre-training and the broader AAR/AA organization.

  • You are able to work in Germany and collaborate regularly on site in Heidelberg as part of the Pre-training team.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Large-Scale Training: Hands-on experience training LLMs or multimodal models on large GPU clusters using distributed frameworks (e.g., Megatron-LM, DeepSpeed, torchtitan).

  • Predictive Scaling: Familiarity with scaling laws, hyperparameter transfer, or methods for predicting large-scale training behavior from smaller proxy runs.

  • Stability & Performance: Experience profiling distributed jobs and diagnosing training anomalies like loss spikes, numerical instability, or optimizer pathologies.

  • Advanced Architectures: Exposure to sparse training approaches (e.g., Mixture-of-Experts) and an understanding of their routing and systems trade-offs.

  • Track Record of Impact: Demonstrated research excellence through top-tier publications (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR), impactful open-source contributions, or significant shipped technical work.

  • Systems Curiosity: Low-level kernel optimization is not required, but we highly value a strong curiosity about the hardware and systems constraints that shape scale.

What we offer

  • Become part of an AI revolution!

  • 30 days of paid vacation

  • Access to a variety of fitness & wellness offerings via Wellhub

  • Mental health support through nilo.health

  • Substantially subsidized company pension plan for your future security

  • Subsidized Germany-wide transportation ticket

  • Budget for additional technical equipment

  • Flexible working hours for better work-life balance and hybrid working model

  • JobRad® Bike Lease

jobs.title: IT-Systemadministrator (m/w/d) – Inhouse-IT & Security
jobs.description:
Über die dokSAFE GmbH

Die dokSAFE GmbH ist ein Leipziger Softwareunternehmen, das sich auf die Entwicklung der SaaS-Lösung ACTAPORT spezialisiert hat. Wir arbeiten gemeinsam daran, mit unserer Kanzleisoftware die Arbeitswelt in der Anwaltskanzlei zu revolutionieren.

Du sorgst dafür, dass jede:r bei uns sicher, schnell und ohne Reibung arbeiten kann, vom ersten Arbeitstag bis zum Offboarding? Dann suchen wir genau DICH! Als IT-Systemadministrator (m/w/d) – Inhouse-IT & Security verantwortest Du eigenständig den Betrieb und die Absicherung unserer gesamten Inhouse-IT (Workplace, Cloud-Services und firmenweites Identity & Access Management), inklusive Datensicherung, Monitoring und Patch-Management aller IT-Systeme. Du arbeitest in einem regulierten Umfeld, in dem Datenschutz und Informationssicherheit zum Produkt gehören. Bei infrastrukturnahen Themen unterstützt Dich unser DevOps-Team.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du betreust den Endgeräte-Lifecycle von Beschaffung bis Entsorgung inklusive Softwareverteilung, führst ein vollständiges Inventar aller IT-Systeme (Endgeräte, Server, Netzwerk- und Speichersysteme, SaaS-Tools) und stellst sicher, dass Sicherheitsupdates zeitnah und nachweisbar eingespielt werden.

  • Du administrierst Microsoft 365 (Entra ID, Exchange, SharePoint, Teams, Intune), Google Workspace, Atlassian (Jira / Confluence) und weitere SaaS-Tenants und behältst den Überblick über Tools, Lizenzen und Admin-Rechte.

  • Du verantwortest unser firmenweites Identity & Access Management (RBAC, SSO via SAML / OIDC, MFA, Conditional Access, Joiner-Mover-Leaver) sowie den Betrieb von VPN und Netzzugängen.

  • Du verantwortest Datensicherung und Wiederherstellung (Backup-Konzept, regelmäßige Restore-Tests) sowie Monitoring, Protokollierung und Alerting unserer Systeme.

  • Du pflegst die virtuellen Maschinen unserer Professional-Services-Umgebungen, steuerst Zugriffe auf Lab- und Migrationsumgebungen und stellst die richtlinienkonforme Nutzung der Fernwartungstools sicher.

  • Bei Sicherheitsvorfällen bist Du erste:r Ansprechpartner:in für das Team: Du dämmst ein, sicherst Spuren und arbeitest mit externen Dienstleistern zusammen.

  • Du setzt verabschiedete Sicherheitsmaßnahmen operativ um, dokumentierst die Umsetzung, arbeitest bei ISO-27001-Nachweisen und Audits zu und unterstützt Security-Awareness im Team. Die Verantwortung für ISMS und Governance liegt bewusst an anderer Stelle.

Deine Qualifikation

  • Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung im Betrieb einer Inhouse-IT mit: Endgeräte und Device Management (z. B. Intune), Windows-Server, virtuelle Maschinen, Datenbanken sowie Netzwerk- und VPN-Betrieb (Patching, Härtung, Fehlersuche). Du kennst Dich mit Backup-/Restore-Konzepten und Monitoring aus.

  • Du hast Praxis in der Administration von Cloud- und SaaS-Umgebungen wie Microsoft 365 / Entra ID oder Google Workspace und im Identity & Access Management: RBAC, SSO, MFA, Conditional Access und On-/Offboarding-Prozesse.

  • Du verstehst Informationssicherheit im regulierten Umfeld (ISO 27001, DSGVO), kennst den Zweck der Controls und kannst sie umsetzen und sauber dokumentieren.

  • Du arbeitest strukturiert und dokumentierst auch ohne Aufforderung, sodass eine Vertretung Deinen Stand übernehmen kann. In einer Einzelrolle priorisierst Du selbst, holst gezielt Unterstützung vom DevOps-Team und eskalierst sauber.

  • Du kommunizierst verhandlungssicher auf Deutsch und sicher auf Englisch für Tooling und Dokumentation sowie für die Kommunikation im Team.

  • Du bist bereit, Dich zur Verschwiegenheit nach § 203 StGB verpflichten zu lassen, denn Du arbeitest mit besonders geschützten Daten von Anwaltskanzleien.

  • Diese Erfahrungen sind ein Plus: als Atlassian-Admin (Jira / Confluence, SCIM-Provisionierung), Scripting mit PowerShell oder Graph API, Erfahrung mit Firewalls und NAS-/Storage-Systemen, Automatisierungstools wie Zapier oder n8n, Mitwirkung an einer ISO-27001-Zertifizierung, Grundlagen eines Cloud-Providers sowie Erfahrung in Legal Tech oder einer anderen datenschutzsensiblen Branche.

Unsere Benefits

  • Mit unserem Büro mitten in der Leipziger Innenstadt sind wir ideal erreichbar.

  • Wir bieten eine sehr gute Work-Life-Balance durch flexible Arbeitszeiten.

  • Wir leben ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell — Homeoffice ist bei uns selbstverständlich möglich.

  • Neben 30 Urlaubstagen erhältst Du eine wettbewerbsfähige Vergütung sowie zusätzliche Benefits (Kitazuschuss, steuerfreier Sachbezug als Deutschlandticket oder 50 €-Gutschein, Bikeleasing).

  • Dich erwarten flachen Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege.

  • Dich begrüßen erfahrene Teamplayer:innen in einem motivierten, inklusiven Team. Nach Deiner ausführlichen Einarbeitung arbeitest Du eigenverantwortlich in diesem.

  • Dich erwarten vielfältige Möglichkeiten für Deine persönliche und fachliche Entwicklung sowie eine optionale betriebliche Altersvorsorge.

Dein Einstieg

Ohne eigenen Finanzierungsberater.
Ohne aktive Kundenansprache.
Ohne eigenen Fokus auf Finanzierung.

Du startest nicht bei null.

Unsere Makler sprechen täglich mit Kaufinteressenten, die eine Finanzierung benötigen.

Du bekommst Zugriff auf unsere bestehenden Kunden und kannst diese aktiv telefonisch und schriftlich ansprechen.

Das Potenzial ist bereits vorhanden.

Deine Aufgabe ist es, daraus Abschlüsse zu machen und gemeinsam mit uns eine starke Finanzierungssparte aufzubauen.

Deine Aufgaben

✅ Beratung unserer Kunden rund um Immobilienfinanzierungen

✅ Aktive telefonische und schriftliche Ansprache unserer Kaufinteressenten

✅ Entwicklung passender Finanzierungslösungen

✅ Enge Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Maklerteam

✅ Perspektivischer Aufbau und Führung eines eigenen Finanzierungsteams

✅ Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Baufinanzierung

(Senior) Product Marketing Manager (d/f/m)
jobs.description:
Location: Zaltbommel, Netherlands (Hybrid)

Reporting to: VP of Marketing


About Cyclomedia & The Role

Cyclomedia creates digital representations of the real world, giving professionals the visual data they need to manage assets and infrastructure. We are currently sharpening our commercial strategy. To drive this, we are looking for a Product Marketing Manager to bridge the gap between our product capabilities and the market.

In our setup, Product Management builds the solution, and Product Marketing wins the market. As part of the Marketing department, you keep our messaging strictly focused on customer value. You own the value propositions, the customer context, and the commercial message. Your output forms the foundation for all our demand generation campaigns.

The Role & Collaboration

As the owner of our value propositions, you define the go-to-market approach. You build this strategy through direct contact with customers and close alignment with sales and Product Management. Armed with this market reality, you brief our Regional Marketing Managers and Content Marketers on the target audiences, messaging, and commercial hooks required for their campaigns. You also work with our Sales Enablement team to ensure sales representatives have the materials they need to close deals.

Key Responsibilities

  • Positioning & Messaging: Translate technical product capabilities into clear positioning and go-to-market strategies that drive pipeline value and improve lead conversion rates.

  • Market Intelligence: Feed the product roadmap with market insights, buyer needs, and competitive intelligence.

  • Sales Alignment: Validate marketing materials with regional sales teams so they are fully equipped to sell the solution.

  • First 6 Months Impact: Work out the context for our top 6 value propositions and produce the foundational global marketing materials to guide upcoming demand and lead generation campaigns.

Your Profile

  • Experience: 5+ years of Product Marketing experience, or a strong commercial background deeply embedded in our core markets.

  • Domain Expertise (Preferred): A background in Geographic Information Systems (GIS) or mobile mapping, or specific industry experience in utility companies, telecom network planning, public or network asset management, or engineering work planning.

  • Commercial Acumen: A proven ability to look from the outside in. You base your strategies on what the buyer needs to hear rather than what the product can do.

  • Ownership: You work independently and possess the maturity to help shape the Product Marketing function as we grow.

What We Offer

  • Room to make your mark: A challenging role in a strong, growing international company, with real freedom to shape the position.

  • A great team to join: A small, close-knit and growing marketing team, plus experienced colleagues to build on.

  • A competitive package: An attractive base salary and an 8.3% annual bonus scheme.

  • Growth: Training, online courses and (team) coaching to support your development.

  • Time off: 25 holidays, the option to buy up to 10 extra days a year, and an extra day off after Ascension Day.

  • Wellbeing: A flexible Mental Health Day each year to rest and recharge, and a sports allowance of €25 gross per month.

  • Hybrid working: 3 days in the office and 2 from home, with a home-working allowance of €2 per day.

  • The right tools: A company phone and laptop.

jobs.title: Superviseur support client international (Support technique opération de tracking sportif) - (H/F)
jobs.description:
McLloyd est une PME technologique française spécialisée dans les solutions de tracking appliquées aux courses. Nos technologies sont notamment utilisées dans plus de 13000 courses hippiques annuelles organisées en France et à l’international.

Dans le cadre du développement de nos activités, notamment en Australie puis aux États-Unis, nous créons un nouveau pôle de supervision chargé d’accompagner nos clients pendant leurs opérations. Ce service a vocation à évoluer progressivement vers une couverture internationale 24 heures sur 24 et 7 jours sur 7. L’équipe, constituée dans un premier temps de deux superviseurs, sera amenée à s’étoffer pour atteindre probablement quatre personnes.

Nous recherchons aujourd’hui notre nouveau superviseur pour participer au lancement et à la construction de ce pôle.

Vos missions

Votre mission

Pendant les opérations de tracking, vous serez le premier point de contact du client. Vous prendrez en charge ses demandes, réaliserez les premières vérifications, résoudrez les incidents simples en direct et transmettrez les situations nécessitant une expertise complémentaire à notre équipe d’ingénieurs (ticketing)

Il s’agit d’un poste opérationnel et technique, sans responsabilité managériale.

Vos principales responsabilités

  • Superviser à distance le bon déroulement des opérations de tracking ;

  • Répondre aux sollicitations des clients pendant les plages de couverture ;

  • Recueillir et qualifier les informations nécessaires à la compréhension d’un incident ;

  • Effectuer les premières vérifications et appliquer les procédures de dépannage ;

  • Résoudre les incidents de premier niveau ;

  • Créer, documenter et suivre les tickets dans notre outil interne ;

  • Transmettre aux ingénieurs les incidents nécessitant une expertise technique approfondie ;

  • Informer le client de l’avancement de sa demande et suivre l’incident jusqu’à sa résolution ou sa transmission complète ;

  • Tenir à jour la documentation interne ;

  • Rédiger les comptes rendus d’opération (% de réussite, interventions et résolutions) quotidiens et mensuels

  • Préparer les opérations à venir et participer à l’amélioration continue du pôle de supervision.L’activité alterne des périodes de supervision en temps réel et des périodes consacrées à la préparation des opérations, au suivi des tickets, à la documentation et à l’amélioration des procédures.

Organisation du travail et horaires

Le poste est organisé en temps plein annualisé. Le planning est établi à l’avance selon le calendrier international des courses et fonctionne par rotation entre les membres de l’équipe.

  • Horaires de journée, prises de poste tôt le matin et horaires de soirée ;

  • À terme, horaires de nuit dans le cadre du développement aux États-Unis ;

  • Travail régulier le week-end et certains jours fériés ;

  • Répartition des plages de couverture entre les superviseurs selon un système de rotation.

Actuellement, certaines opérations peuvent commencer dès 3 heures et se terminer jusqu’à 22 heures. Avec le développement de nos activités aux États-Unis, certaines plages de supervision pourront être réalisées pendant la nuit.

L’organisation des rotations sera réalisée dans le respect du temps de travail annualisé, des temps de repos et des dispositions légales et conventionnelles applicables. Les heures de nuit, du dimanche et des jours fériés donneront lieu aux majorations ou compensations prévues au sein de l’entreprise. Cette organisation implique une réelle disponibilité et l’acceptation d’horaires variables. Elle ne signifie toutefois pas que chaque superviseur travaillera systématiquement la nuit ou tous les week-ends.

Vos compétences

Profil recherché

  • Personne sérieuse, ponctuelle, fiable, calme et méthodique face à un incident ;

  • Autonomie et capacité à travailler efficacement à distance ;

  • Aisance dans la relation client, par téléphone comme par écrit ;

  • Capacité à recueillir des informations précises et à les transmettre clairement ;

  • Aisance avec les outils informatiques et les environnements techniques ;

  • Respect des procédures et attention portée à la qualité de la documentation ;

  • Disponibilité pour travailler selon un planning tournant comprenant des horaires de jour, de nuit, de week-end et certains jours fériés ;

  • Connexion internet stable et environnement adapté au télétravail.

Anglais courant obligatoire, à l’oral comme à l’écrit.

Une expérience professionnelle d’au moins deux ans en support client, assistance technique, supervision d’opérations, exploitation informatique, maintenance à distance ou gestion d’incidents est requise.

La connaissance du secteur hippique constitue un plus, mais elle n’est pas indispensable. Une formation aux solutions et aux procédures Mclloyd sera assurée en interne.

Avantages

Conditions proposées

  • CDI à temps plein annualisé ;

  • Majorations ou compensations applicables aux horaires concernés ;

  • Poste exercé à 100 % en télétravail, exclusivement depuis un lieu de travail déclaré situé sur le territoire français. Le télétravail depuis l’étranger n’est pas autorisé

  • Planning organisé par rotation et communiqué à l’avance ;

  • Déplacements ponctuels possibles au siège ou sur certaines opérations, notamment pendant la période de formation ;

  • Formation technique assurée en interne ;

  • Participation à la création d’un nouveau pôle stratégique pour le développement international de Mac-Lloyd.

Pourquoi rejoindre McLloyd

Vous intégrerez une PME technologique en pleine évolution et participerez directement à la création d’un nouveau service international. Vous occuperez un poste concret, autonome et utile aux clients, au contact d’opérations sportives organisées en France et à l’étranger. Vous contribuerez également à la définition des procédures et à l’organisation d’une équipe amenée à se développer progressivement

jobs.title: Rocket Engine Injector Modelling and Design Tools Development Intern
jobs.description:
About Pangea Propulsion:

We are a company dedicated to developing advanced propulsion systems for the space industry based on three key principles: high efficiency, sustainability, and reusability. We are revolutionizing the space industry with ground-breaking innovations that allow us to offer the best performance to cost propulsion systems.

Our goal is to be the propulsion provider for the next generation of spacecraft, which is essential to meet demands and compete in the booming space market of the next decade.

We are a passionate, multicultural, and multidisciplinary team pushing the boundaries of what is possible in space propulsion technology.

We have already made history by successfully testing the world's first 3D-printed Methalox Aerospike engine, marking a significant milestone for the space industry.

We are looking for talented professionals to join our international teams in Barcelona and Toulouse. We want to be a key player in improving diversity in the Aerospace sector as, in Pangea, we believe that diversity (gender, age, race, sexual orientation, beliefs, disability, culture, etc.) is a key to success. Within Pangea, everyone can grow with the same opportunities. We encourage you to apply. Individually we are different, but together we are an amazing team!

We are looking for a Rocket Engine Injector Modelling and Design Tool Development intern for a 6-month internship in Toulouse.

About the role

We are looking for a motivated engineering intern to join our Combustion Devices team and contribute to the development of engineering tools supporting the design and analysis of liquid rocket engine injectors.

During this internship, you will work on computational tools to automate and accelerate the preliminary design and assessment of injector configurations.

Your work will focus on three main areas:

  • Injector layout & manifold modelling: develop tools to automate injector element layouts and associated fuel and oxidiser manifolds, based on geometrical, fluid-dynamic and engineering design rules.
  • Injector spray-pattern visualisation: develop a qualitative visualisation of spray/jet directions, cone angles, spatial coverage and interactions between neighbouring injector elements.
  • Face-plate thermal assessment: contribute to a physics-based methodology to assess thermal loads based on injector configuration, local mixture ratio, spray angle, injection conditions and combustion behaviour.


The developed tools will support the team in rapidly comparing injector configurations, identifying potential performance and thermal risks, and improving the overall preliminary design process.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review existing injector design methodologies, engineering rules and relevant technical literature.
  • Develop algorithms for automated injector layout and fuel/oxidiser manifold generation.
  • Implement engineering models and methodologies in MATLAB and Python.
  • Develop an injector spray-pattern visualisation tool.
  • Develop preliminary models to assess injector face-plate thermal loads.
  • Use relevant parameters such as injector configuration, local mixture ratio, spray angle and injection/combustion conditions.
  • Define relevant CFD analysis needs and interpret available CFD and experimental data.
  • Validate models and tools against available analytical, numerical, experimental or literature data.
  • Document methodologies, assumptions, limitations and recommendations for future development and integration into the Combustion Devices design process.


What you need to be successful

  • Final-year student or recent graduate in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Energy Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Strong programming skills, particularly in MATLAB and Python.
  • Good understanding of:
    • Fluid mechanics
    • Thermodynamics and heat transfer
    • Numerical methods and computational modelling
  • Experience with data processing, numerical analysis or scientific computing.
  • Ability to translate physical and engineering requirements into computational models and algorithms.
  • Ability to analyse numerical results and identify relevant physical trends.
  • Critical thinking when assessing modelling assumptions and engineering correlations.
  • Interest in rocket propulsion, combustion devices and liquid-propellant injection systems.
  • Fluent written and spoken English.


Soft Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Autonomous, structured and methodical approach.
  • Curiosity and willingness to explore unfamiliar technical topics.
  • Ability to collaborate within a multicultural and multidisciplinary engineering team.
  • Good technical communication and documentation skills.
  • Attention to detail and critical thinking.


Nice to have

Any of the following would be a plus, but is not required:

  • Experience with liquid rocket engine injectors, combustion chambers or other combustion systems.
  • Knowledge of coaxial, impinging-jet, swirl or pintle injectors.
  • Knowledge of multiphase flows, sprays, atomisation or propellant mixing.
  • Knowledge of combustion physics, reacting flows or turbulent heat transfer.
  • Experience with thermal modelling or heat-transfer correlations.
  • Experience with CFD tools, post-processing or interpretation of reacting-flow/heat-transfer simulations.
  • Experience analysing parameters such as local mixture ratio, spray angle, wall heat flux or wall temperature.
  • Experience developing engineering correlations from numerical or experimental data.
  • Experience with geometrical algorithms, optimisation or automated engineering design tools.
  • Experience developing graphical interfaces or engineering visualisation tools.
  • Familiarity with Git or other version-control tools.


Expected internship outcomes

By the end of the internship, you will have contributed to:

  • A functional MATLAB/Python tool for automated injector layout and manifold definition.
  • An injector spray-pattern visualisation tool.
  • A preliminary physics-based methodology for assessing injector face-plate thermal loads.
  • Validation of the developed methodologies against available literature, CFD, experimental or reference data.
  • Technical documentation covering the tools, methodologies, assumptions, limitations and recommendations for future integration.


Supervision and collaboration

You will be supervised by an engineer from the Combustion Devices team and collaborate closely with the future users of the tools. Technical priorities, verification cases and acceptance criteria will be reviewed regularly to ensure that the tools address practical engineering needs.

Not hitting every requirement? Research suggests that some people tend to hesitate when it comes to job applications if they don't meet all the desired qualifications. Here at Pangea Propulsion, we're committed to fostering a workplace that values diversity, inclusivity, and authenticity. So, if you're enthusiastic about this role but your prior experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification mentioned in the job description, we still strongly encourage you to apply. You might just be the ideal candidate for this position or other opportunities within our organization.

Pangea Propulsion is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We consider all applications without discrimination on any legally protected grounds. We welcome applications from persons with disabilities and we can provide reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process and in the workplace.

More about us…

We are an international and very multicultural team. Our work is guided by these core values:

Teamwork: We strive to work together as an aligned team towards our common goals.

Respect & tolerance: we value people with integrity that treat other people with respect. We enjoy having diverse views to enrich the debate and take better decisions.

Passion for growth: we are passionate about space and about being pioneers; also, we value personal and organizational growth aiming to a constant improvement.

Sustainability: because a long-term vision and strategy is not possible if sustainability is not in the team’s core values.

Daring: we do things that sometimes seem impossible, but we always go the extra mile to find a path to do them and we are ready to take the necessary risks to achieve our goals.

If this sounds good to you and you want to join the New Space revolution, we really want to meet you!

jobs.title: Integration Specialist – Electronic Data Interchange (EDI)
jobs.description:
We Want You to Grow With Us 

We are strengthening our EDI integration capabilities at Intersnack IT. As our next Integration Specialist – EDI, you will bring your experience in electronic data interchange and your understanding of business processes to support reliable transactions between our business units, trading partners and applications.

Your knowledge of Order to Cash (O2C) and Source to Pay (S2P) will help you translate business requirements into effective integration solutions. Based in Düsseldorf, you will work closely with our Application Service Delivery & Support and Business Transformation teams, business stakeholders and external EDI providers, supporting both daily operations and international ERP initiatives.

What We Can Offer 

This position combines hands-on EDI development with responsibility for integrations that support our supply chain. You will apply your business process knowledge to practical technical solutions and contribute to global ERP initiatives and local EDI rollouts.

If you bring strong EDI expertise and experience with O2C and S2P processes, we can support your onboarding into the Infor M3 integration stack. You will build on your existing knowledge while becoming familiar with our applications, mapping tools and integration environment.

You will join a supportive, international IT team, working alongside colleagues and specialist providers with opportunities to deepen your expertise in integration delivery and EDI operations.

How You Will Spend Your Time as Our Next Integration Specialist – EDI 

You will connect business requirements with the technical delivery and operation of EDI integrations. Your work will span document mapping, integration configuration, rollout support and daily troubleshooting, helping ensure that transactions are processed reliably across our Infor applications and external EDI networks.

What You Will Do 

  • Translate business requirements and trading partner specifications into practical EDI solutions, supporting document flows across Order to Cash, Logistics and Source to Pay.

  • Create and maintain complex document mappings, transforming partner messages into standard XML formats and vice versa.

  • Develop, configure and maintain EDI integrations across Infor M3, Infor ION, Infor OS and Infor Enterprise Collaborator (IEC/MEC).

  • Define and maintain mapping standards, data validation rules and interface specifications, supported by clear functional and technical documentation.

  • Support EDI workstreams within global ERP initiatives and local rollouts across business units, maintaining consistency with global integration templates.

  • Monitor daily EDI transactions, prioritise critical issues and resolve integration or transmission failures to help prevent supply chain disruptions.

  • Analyse performance across EDI networks and clearing centres, identify recurring errors and bottlenecks, and coordinate configuration adjustments and testing with external providers.

  • Maintain standard messages and application interfaces in line with relevant industry standards and data compliance requirements.

  • Collaborate with internal IT teams, business stakeholders and external providers to deliver and support integrations involving both Infor and other applications.

What We Expect of You 

Essential Skills & Experience 

  • Strong familiarity with the document sequences supporting core supply chain processes such as Order to Cash (O2C) , Logistics and Source to Pay (S2P), including orders, invoices and shipping notices.

  • Extensive hands-on experience in Electronic Data Interchange (EDI), B2B integration frameworks and complex data mapping environments.

  • Strong technical proficiency in EDI mapping tools, XML schemas and data transformation languages.

  • Good awareness of global B2B messaging standards, such as EDIFACT, and electronic communication protocols.

  • Proven ability to read and analyse Java code in Eclipse IDE to debug custom mapping extensions and data routing rules.

  • Strong communication and technical documentation skills, with the ability to translate business and trading partner requirements into clear mapping and interface specifications.

  • Ability to work effectively in a complex, collaborative matrix environment with virtual teams in a multi-cultural and geographically diverse setting.

  • Strong analytical mindset, problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, including root-cause analysis of data payload errors and transmission failures, with sound judgement in challenging situations.

  • A strong command of spoken and written English is required, and knowledge of German is considered a plus.

AI Software Developer (m/w/d).

  • Know-how teilen: Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit unserem Tech-Team neue Standards für KI-gestützte Softwareentwicklung und hilfst dabei, das gesamte Team effizienter zu machen.

Julia und das Team von Sunlab

jobs.title: Werkstudent oder Praktikant Recruiting & Active Sourcing (m/w/d) – 100 % Remote
jobs.description:
Über Best Talents

Find, hire and retain the best talent.

Recruiting ist unsere Kernkompetenz. Best Talents Consulting GmbH ist eine Recruiting- und Interim-Recruiting-Beratung aus Berlin. Wir beraten unsere Mandanten (Start-ups, Scale-ups, KMU und Konzerne) in operativen und strategischen Fragestellungen von A-Z (Recruiting, Active Sourcing, Interim Recruiting, Business Coaching, Outplacement, Trainings und HR Management) und helfen ihnen dabei, die besten am Markt verfügbaren Kandidatinnen und Kandidaten zu finden. Unser Modell: Wir arbeiten auf Stundenbasis statt auf Provision – transparent, partnerschaftlich und ohne Vermittlungsgebühr.

Unser erfahrenes Berater-Team besetzt deutschlandweit erfolgreich verschiedenste Positionen (von Geschäftsführerin und C-Level über Fach- und Führungskräfte bis hin zum Azubi) in diversen Branchen (E-Commerce, Retail, SaaS/Tech, Maschinenbau oder Logistik uvm.) bei namhaften Kunden (Flink, Flip, Hermès, Zalando, Zeppelin, RIMOWA, FactFinder, TWAICE, uvm.).

Du bist gerade mitten im Studium und auf der Suche nach einem flexiblen Werkstudentenjob oder einem Praktikum im Recruiting, den Du 100 % Remote ausüben kannst?

Du hast bereits erste Erfahrungen im Recruiting oder Active Sourcing gesammelt und möchtest sie jetzt in echten Mandaten vertiefen? Du hast Spaß am direkten Kontakt mit Bewerbern und möchtest uns im täglichen Rennen um neue Talente unterstützen?

Dann lies unbedingt weiter.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Recruiting Teams in Berlin suchen wir eine:n Werkstudent oder Praktikant Recruiting / Active Sourcing (m/w/d) zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt – remote aus ganz Deutschland.

In dieser Position arbeitest Du eng mit unserem Senior Recruiter zusammen. Du unterstützt im Tagesgeschäft und übernimmst eigenverantwortlich das Active Sourcing für spannende Positionen bei namhaften Kunden – vor allem Sales-, GTM- und Tech-Rollen bei Start-ups und Scale-ups. Eine grandiose Candidate Experience zu gestalten ist für Dich hierbei selbstverständlich.

Unser Must-have: Vorerfahrung im Recruiting, idealerweise im Active Sourcing. Alles andere lässt sich lernen – und wir passen den Job Deinen Stärken an.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Du übernimmst das Active Sourcing via LinkedIn (Recruiter) und XING eigenständig, baust Suchstrings und Talent-Pools auf und unterstützt beim Kandidatenscreening.

  • Du verwaltest, pflegst und organisierst die Kandidaten-Pipeline im ATS (z. B. Personio, Ashby), stehst im aktiven Austausch mit nationalen sowie internationalen Talenten (Terminvereinbarung, Nachforderung fehlender Informationen, Absagen) und sorgst mit Deiner professionellen Bewerberkommunikation für eine positive Candidate Experience.

  • Du erstellst attraktive Stellenanzeigen, die im Gedächtnis bleiben (wenn Du gleich einen Vorschlag für diese Anzeige hast, nur her damit ;-)).

  • Du kannst Deine Kreativität in verschiedenen Projekten mit dem Schwerpunkt Recruiting, Employer Branding und KI-gestütztes Sourcing einbringen.

  • Du bist stets auf der Suche nach neuen, innovativen Direct-Search-Kanälen und hilfst uns bei der Weiterentwicklung von zielgruppenspezifischen Recruiting-Strategien.

  • Du hast darüber hinaus weitere Ideen, wie Du uns optimal unterstützen kannst? Dann lass uns unbedingt sprechen, wir freuen uns auf den Austausch mit Dir!

Deine Skills:

Must-haves:

  • Du hast bereits Erfahrung im Recruiting gesammelt – z. B. als Werkstudent:in, Praktikant:in oder in einer HR-Rolle – idealerweise im Active Sourcing / Direct Search über LinkedIn oder XING.

  • Du bist an einer anerkannten (Fach-)Hochschule immatrikuliert (Werkstudium) oder suchst ein Pflicht- bzw. freiwilliges Praktikum (3–6 Monate). Die Fachrichtung ist zweitrangig.

  • Du wohnst in Deutschland (Voraussetzung für die Anstellung) und arbeitest remote.

  • Deine Deutschkenntnisse sind verhandlungssicher (mind. C1), Deine Englischkenntnisse sind verhandlungssicher.

  • Du hast ca. 20 Stunden die Woche Zeit, um uns zu unterstützen (Praktikum in Voll- oder Teilzeit möglich).

Was uns außerdem wichtig ist:

  • Du bist neugierig, hast Lust auf das Thema Recruiting und Talent Acquisition, kannst Dir schnell neue Themen aneignen und würdest lieber heute als morgen loslegen.

  • Du scheust Dich nicht, Dinge zu hinterfragen und hast einen hohen Qualitätsanspruch an Deine Arbeit.

  • Du hast sehr gute kommunikative Fähigkeiten in Wort und Schrift.

  • Du kennst Deine Stärken und erkennst schnell, wie Du diese einbringen kannst und uns optimal unterstützt.

  • Du hast Spaß daran, selbstständig zu arbeiten, bist dienstleistungsorientiert sowie flexibel.

Unsere Benefits:

  • Attraktive Stundenvergütung + erfolgsabhängiger Bonus bei entsprechender Erfahrung oder Praktikumsvergütung

  • 20 bezahlte Urlaubstage pro Jahr (bei 20 Std./Woche), damit Du neben Studium und Arbeit eine optimale Erholung bekommst.

  • Arbeit zu 100 % Remote in Deutschland – optional Treffen mit dem Team in Berlin.

  • Maximale Flexibilität in Bezug auf Deine Arbeitszeiten – uns ist es egal, wann Du Deine Arbeit erledigst. Hauptsache die Qualität stimmt!

  • Abwechslungsreicher Arbeitsalltag, vielfältige Aufgaben, flache Hierarchien, kurze Entscheidungswege, offene, transparente Kommunikation und steile Lernkurve – Du siehst den kompletten Recruiting-Prozess von der Suche bis zur Einstellung.

  • Professionelles Tool-Setup: LinkedIn Recruiter, moderne ATS und KI-Tools im Sourcing-Alltag.

  • Unterschiedliche Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten für Deine berufliche Entwicklung – lass uns das individuell für Dich festlegen.

  • Viel Raum zur persönlichen Entfaltung und zum eigenverantwortlichen Arbeiten in Deiner neuen Rolle.

  • Arbeit in einem kleinen, erfahrenen Team sowie die Möglichkeit, Deine individuellen Stärken und Ideen einzubringen.

  • Chance, eine wachsende Recruiting-Beratung aktiv mitzugestalten und das Thema Recruiting neu zu denken!

  • Auf Wunsch ist Vollbeschäftigung in der vorlesungsfreien Zeit möglich.

Häufige Fragen (FAQ)

Kann ich komplett remote arbeiten? Ja, zu 100 % – Voraussetzung ist ein Wohnsitz in Deutschland.

Wie viele Stunden pro Woche? Als Werkstudent:in ca. 20 Stunden (in der vorlesungsfreien Zeit mehr möglich), im Praktikum Voll- oder Teilzeit – wie es zu Deinem Studium passt.

Brauche ich Vorerfahrung? Ja – erste Erfahrung im Recruiting, idealerweise im Active Sourcing, ist unser Must-have.

Wann kann ich starten? Ab sofort bzw. zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt.

Wie läuft die Bewerbung ab? Kurzer Lebenslauf oder LinkedIn-Profil genügt – kein Anschreiben nötig. Der Prozess hat zwei Runden: ein 30-minütiges Video-Interview zum Kennenlernen und ein 30-minütiges Case-Study-Interview mit einer praxisnahen Sourcing-Aufgabe. Nach jeder Runde bekommst Du innerhalb von 48 Stunden eine Rückmeldung.

Kontakt:

Mirko Duus · Geschäftsführer, Best Talents Consulting GmbH, Berlin

https://www.linkedin.com/in/mirkoduus/

jobs.description:
BodyFast – die Nr. 1 Intervallfasten-App weltweit

Über uns:
BodyFast gehört mit über 50 Millionen Downloads zu den führenden Health-Apps weltweit und wurde von Apple mehrfach ausgezeichnet. Gemeinsam mit unserem strategischen Partner Wort & Bild Verlag / Isartal Health Media entwickeln wir ein wachsendes Portfolio digitaler Produkte im Bereich Health, Fitness, Wellness und darüber hinaus.

Wir sind ein agiles Unternehmen mit Start-up-Mentalität, kurzen Entscheidungswegen und einer klaren Vision: Mit AI-gestützter Produktentwicklung wollen wir innovative Consumer Apps deutlich schneller und effizienter von der ersten Idee bis zur Marktreife bringen.

Dafür suchen wir einen Head of Product, der nicht nur Produktstrategien entwickelt und Teams führt, sondern selbst mit modernen AI-Tools arbeitet, Prototypen und MVPs baut und unsere Ideen gemeinsam mit Entwicklung, Design und QA in erfolgreiche Apps verwandelt.

Aufgaben

Deine Rolle:

Als Head of Product bist du die zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Geschäftsführung, Produktentwicklung, Design, Engineering und QA.

Du übersetzt strategische Ideen in konkrete Produktkonzepte, entwickelst gemeinsam mit den Gründern neue App-Ideen und bringst diese mithilfe moderner AI-Tools schnell bis zum funktionsfähigen Prototypen oder MVP.

Anschließend koordinierst du die professionelle Weiterentwicklung, Qualitätssicherung und Veröffentlichung durch unsere Teams.

Du übernimmst Führungsverantwortung, setzt klare Prioritäten und stellst sicher, dass aus Ideen schnell hochwertige, nutzerfreundliche und wirtschaftlich erfolgreiche Produkte werden.

Deine Schwerpunkte:

  • Produktstrategie & Innovation: Gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung entwickelst du neue Produktideen, bewertest Marktpotenziale und übersetzt Visionen in konkrete Konzepte, Roadmaps und Prioritäten.

  • AI-native Prototyping & MVP Development: Du setzt moderne AI-Coding-Tools wie Claude Code und Codex selbst ein, um funktionsfähige Prototypen und MVPs zu entwickeln, Produktideen schnell zu testen und Entwicklungszyklen drastisch zu verkürzen.

  • Produktentwicklung & UX/UI: Du verantwortest die Produktkonzeption von der User Journey über UX/UI und Feature-Design bis zur Marktreife. Dabei hast du ein ausgeprägtes Gespür für intuitive, attraktive und nutzerfreundliche Consumer Apps.

  • Führung & Teamkoordination: Du führst und koordinierst interdisziplinäre Teams aus Produktmanagement, Entwicklung, Design und QA, sorgst für klare Anforderungen, Verantwortlichkeiten und eine effiziente Zusammenarbeit.

  • Schnittstelle zwischen Business & Tech: Du verbindest unternehmerische Ziele mit technischer Umsetzung, formulierst klare Entwicklungsaufträge und steuerst deren Umsetzung bis zum erfolgreichen Release.

  • Quality Assurance & Release Management: Du definierst Qualitätsanforderungen, strukturierst Test- und Feedbackprozesse und arbeitest eng mit Entwicklung und QA zusammen, um zuverlässige, hochwertige Releases sicherzustellen.

  • Growth & Monetarisierung: Du optimierst unsere Apps kontinuierlich hinsichtlich Conversion, Retention, Engagement und Umsatz durch datengetriebene Entscheidungen und Experimente.

  • Produktportfolio: Du entwickelst bestehende Apps wie BodyFast weiter und treibst gemeinsam mit den Gründern den Aufbau neuer digitaler Consumer-Produkte voran.

  • AI-first Workflows: Du etablierst AI-gestützte Prozesse in Konzeption, Design, Entwicklung, Testing und Automatisierung, um Geschwindigkeit, Effizienz und Qualität nachhaltig zu steigern.

  • Performance & Analytics: Du definierst relevante Produkt-KPIs, analysierst Nutzerverhalten und leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen zur Produktverbesserung ab.

Qualifikation

Was du mitbringen solltest:

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Steuerung digitaler Produkte, idealerweise im Bereich Consumer Apps oder Mobile Apps.

  • Nachweisbare Führungserfahrung in der Leitung und Koordination interdisziplinärer Produkt- und Entwicklungsteams.

  • Praktische Erfahrung mit AI-gestützter Softwareentwicklung: Du hast bereits selbst mit Tools wie Claude Code, Codex oder vergleichbaren Lösungen gearbeitet und damit funktionierende Anwendungen, Prototypen oder MVPs umgesetzt.

  • Sehr gutes Verständnis für moderne App-Architekturen, Entwicklungsprozesse und die Zusammenarbeit mit Softwareentwicklern. Du musst kein klassischer Senior Developer sein, solltest aber technisch fundiert mitreden und selbst Lösungen umsetzen können.

  • Ausgeprägtes Gespür für UX/UI, Produktdesign, intuitive Nutzerführung und die Anforderungen erfolgreicher Consumer Apps.

  • Erfahrung darin, Produktideen von der ersten Konzeption über Prototyping und Entwicklung bis zum erfolgreichen Launch zu begleiten.

  • Fähigkeit, technische und fachliche Anforderungen klar zu formulieren, Entwicklungsaufgaben zu strukturieren und die Qualität der Ergebnisse zu beurteilen.

  • Unternehmerisches Denken, Kreativität und ein ausgeprägter Wille, neue Produkte schnell und erfolgreich auf den Markt zu bringen.

  • Hohe Eigeninitiative, klare Kommunikation und eine echte Hands-on- und Ownership-Mentalität.

  • Begeisterung für die Möglichkeiten von AI und die Motivation, klassische Produktentwicklungsprozesse grundlegend neu zu denken.

Benefits

Wir bieten:

  • Eine zentrale Führungsrolle bei einer der weltweit führenden Intervallfasten-Apps mit über 50 Millionen Downloads.

  • Die Möglichkeit, gemeinsam mit den Gründern ein neues Portfolio innovativer Consumer Apps aufzubauen.

Du willst nicht nur Roadmaps verwalten, sondern selbst Produkte erschaffen?
